races.race_name: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Valedictory
runners.spotlight: Stepped up to 1m6f with cheekpieces enlisted for last two starts and won them both, doing it smoothly at this track (good) and having to battle when prevailing by a neck in valuable race at Newmarket (good to firm); raised another 3lb but looks a serious contender once again.
runners.comment: 2-2 over 1m6f in cheekpieces, doing it smoothly here before narrow winner of valuable race

runners.name: Nightime Dancer
runners.spotlight: Contested three Group races last summer; it's been 1m4f handicaps (good to firm) this season, registering his highest rating when fourth of eight at Newmarket in May but two disappointing shows at Ascot have followed; blinkered latest; stays at least 1m5f (unraced over this far) and he's 6lb lower than at Newmarket, but some caution is advised at present.
runners.comment: Creditable reappearance before disappointing at Ascot on last two starts, blinkered latest

runners.name: Hopewell Rock
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in handicaps, with regular progress/promise but not when favourite last time at Royal Ascot where he raced freely early on and ran out of steam after challenging over 2f out (finished 8l sixth of 17); it's much too early to forget his reappearance promise (also 1m4f on good to firm) but that latest run also casts some doubt on the suitability of this new trip.
runners.comment: 0-6 in handicaps, with regular progress/promise but too free early last time; up in trip

runners.name: Stressfree
runners.spotlight: Not a prolific winner, with his waiting tactics, but he was fourth in the Ebor at York (1m6f, good to firm) last August off a 2lb higher mark; ran creditably on reappearance, before neither start since panned out favourably; only ninth in this last year on his only run at Goodwood.
runners.comment: Not a prolific winner, with waiting tactics; Ebor 4th at York last August off 2lb higher

runners.name: Sing Us A Song
runners.spotlight: Upset in the stalls when a disappointing favourite at this meeting last year (subsequently gelded); had a 1m6f win next time and solid performances when beaten about 3l on all three starts this season, sixth of 16 when back up to 1m6f at Royal Ascot latest; others saw it out better that day but he should have serious each-way claims.
runners.comment: Solid performances when beaten about 3l on all three starts this season; each-way claims

runners.name: Small Fry
runners.spotlight: 1m4f festival wins off much lower marks at Chester and Epsom last July when trained by the Moores; returned to Flat with an eye-catching effort at Royal Ascot (2m4f, good to firm; 12-1) last month, turning for home towards rear but running on into sixth of 20; back down in trip but one to note.
runners.comment: Eye-catching return at Royal Ascot (2m4f, good to firm); back down in trip but one to note

runners.name: Incensed
runners.spotlight: Two big runs over 1m4f here, including when third of nine in Listed race in May; not quite so good in two Ascot handicaps (1m6f/1m4f) since and there's a bit more to prove at this trip but that Listed run reads well.
runners.comment: There's a bit more to prove at this trip but her 1m4f Listed 3rd at this track reads well

runners.name: Bahadur
runners.spotlight: Won five-runner race here (upped to 2m, good) in May and made most when fifth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW); no room over 1f out at Newbury two weeks ago but the speed with which he dropped out when jockey gave up was still rather disconcerting; place chance if bouncing back.
runners.comment: 2m winner here and fifth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate; no room over 1f out latest
runners.owner: J William Rowley & S P C Woods

runners.name: Tarriance
runners.spotlight: The future looked bright when he won the Melrose at York (1m6f, good to firm) last August but he's not built on that significantly; well held back in Britain for two Group races this May when last seen; off 12lb higher than in the Melrose, this return to a handicap may also be tough.
runners.comment: Well held back in Britain for two Group races this May; this handicap may also be tough

runners.name: Align The Stars
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2024 before embarking on a long losing run; he's broken that with two 2m wins on the AW this year, most notably in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle last time; second in valuable race at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) in May was followed by a blip here; back up another 4lb since Newcastle but not entirely ruled out.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024; back up another 4lb since Northumberland Plate win last time

runners.name: Burdett Road
runners.spotlight: 2023 Royal Ascot winner who has also tasted the high life in top hurdle races; his attentions have been turned back to the Flat this year and he hasn't been in peak form; falling in the weights but still needs a revival; good 5lb claimer is enlisted.
runners.comment: Falling in the weights but still needs a revival; good 5lb claimer is enlisted

runners.name: Aeronautic
runners.spotlight: Close third in this last year and a creditable, running-on fourth of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) latest start; strong each-way chance.
runners.comment: Close 3rd in this last year and a creditable, running-on 4th at Royal Ascot latest start

runners.name: Nesthorn
runners.spotlight: 2-5 in France and also scored in December in Bahrain for new connections; fourth of eight at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago was probably his best form but better is needed and he didn't settle well enough behind horses that day, so is seemingly not crying out for this longer trip.
runners.comment: 4th of eight at Ascot (1m4f) three weeks ago was probably his best form; better is needed

runners.name: Al Aasy
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has won the last two runnings of this race (good to firm/good to soft) and has run well on both starts this season, most recently posting a cosy Listed win at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm); leading claims.
runners.comment: Has won the last 2 runnings of this race and was a Listed winner last time; leading claims

runners.name: In My Teens
runners.spotlight: Didn't really take to hurdling but she relished the step up in trip in this code when easily winning a 13-runner handicap at the Curragh (1m4f, good) in June; she has to prove that brilliance was no one-off but it was certainly an impressive performance and she could have a part to play today.
runners.comment: Easily won handicap at the Curragh on first crack at 1m4f and could have a part to play

runners.name: Opportunity
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) in May on his second start since being gelded and followed up in the Duke Of Edinburgh Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); he's by Frankel out of a Group 1 winner and could take this rise in grade in his stride; key player.
runners.comment: Impressed in Royal Ascot h'cap and could take this rise in grade in his stride; key player

runners.name: Enfjaar
runners.spotlight: He's run well on both visits to Goodwood, latest a close third in 1m2f Listed race here (good) in May after an absence, and the late headway he made when eighth in the Listed Wolferton at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) suggests this step up in trip could be a good move; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Late headway over 1m2f at Royal Ascot suggests this step up in trip could be a good move
runners.owner: T & Mrs L Standish & Mrs A Spence

runners.name: Ghostwriter
runners.spotlight: He was returning from a year off when down the field in the Wolferton at Royal Ascot in June, and may have needed that first run for Kevin Philippart De Foy; classy performer for Clive Cox prior to £2,000,000 sale, making the frame in several Group 1s, and can have a big say if back to his best.
runners.comment: Down the field on sole run this year but may have needed it; classy performer on his day

runners.name: Involvement
runners.spotlight: Won Meydan handicap (9.5f, good) in March and ran well in defeat in Listed races on next two starts (including here over 1m2f); however, no match for Al Aasy in Listed race at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) four weeks ago and others have more substance to their claims.
runners.comment: Some good Listed form in the spring (including here) but no match for Al Aasy last time

runners.name: King's Gambit
runners.spotlight: Late headway once in the clear in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) in June, finishing seventh of 16, and outclassed in the Eclipse since (well beaten at 100-1); drops back in grade and the step back up in trip is worth a go, but he's 0-13 in Group/Listed races since winning the London Gold Cup in May 2024 and may again find a few too good.
runners.comment: Drops back in grade and the step back up in trip is worth a go but losing run continues

runners.name: Midak
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who won Group 3 at Saint-Cloud (10.5f, good) last May; respectable Listed efforts on last two starts (including C&D) but hasn't shown enough on those outings to suggest he'll be making an impact today.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown enough in Listed races on last two starts to suggest he'll make an impact

runners.name: Danielle
runners.spotlight: Second to Waardah in this last year and fourth to Santorini Star and Consent in Group 2 at Doncaster (14.5f, good to soft) last September; routed her rivals in Listed event (1m2f, heavy) in November and reappeared with Group 3 win at York (1m6f, good; made most at 1-2) ten weeks ago; unraced on good to firm since 2024 (comfortably held); serious player if the ground is okay.
runners.comment: Second in this last year; reappeared with Group 3 win at York (1m6f, good) ten weeks ago

runners.name: Santorini Star
runners.spotlight: Duelled with Consent over 1m6f last year; progressive ways continued in May with a win at Newmarket (substandard 1m4f Group 2, good to firm) and close second in Group 1 at Longchamp (near 2m, soft); the Hardwicke back over 1m4f at Royal Ascot six weeks ago was a stiff task and she hung right in first-time cheekpieces on her way to a heavy defeat; much more interesting today with no headgear and back up in trip.
runners.comment: Stiff task at Royal Ascot; much more interesting here with no headgear and back up in trip

runners.name: Consent
runners.spotlight: Pipped by Santorini Star in Group 2 at Doncaster (14.5f, good to soft) in September but turned the tables on her in fine style in Group 1 at Longchamp (1m6f, soft) in October; cut out tamely in the final 2f of another French Group 1 (near 2m, soft) on return but ten weeks have passed; never having raced on firmer than good asks quite a question but tough to beat if back to her best.
runners.comment: Unraced on firmer than good; tame reappearance but tough to beat if back to her 2025 best

runners.name: Amelia Earhart
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with 2l win in the Listed Cheshire Oaks at Chester (11.3f, good); soundly beaten when favourite for the Oaks itself on testing ground at Epsom and put firmly in her place when fifth in Irish Oaks at the Curragh (1m4f, good to firm; 5-1); wore a hood and blinkers on first two starts this season, just cheekpieces on latest; some limitations have seemingly been exposed and others saw the race out better in her two Oaks bids.
runners.comment: Cheshire Oaks winner; limitations have seemingly been exposed in the Oaks and Irish Oaks
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Goodie Two Shoes
runners.spotlight: 5l third to Waardah in this last year, before career best when second in the Melbourne Cup (2m); back to best European form when second in Group 3 at Fairyhouse (1m6f, good; unraced on firmer) this month but will probably have to settle for a place here if others show their best.
runners.comment: 5l third in this last year; career best when 2nd in Melbourne Cup; ran creditably latest

runners.name: Waardah
runners.spotlight: Won twice here (soft/good to soft) last summer, latterly when leading over 2f out in this race and seeing off Danielle's challenge by three-quarters of a length; ran moderately on final 3yo start but reappearance this May was positive when second to a class act in Group 3 at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm); big player if back to her peak.
runners.comment: Won this last year from Danielle; 2nd to a class act in 1m3f Group 3 at Carlisle on return

runners.name: Completely Random
runners.spotlight: Finished eighth behind Two Tribes in this race 12 months ago when 4lb lower; he is a better horse now, as emphasised by two 6f AW wins in January and a fine second in the Wokingham (cheekpieces first time) but he finished behind Two Tribes at Ascot last week and others look more appealing for win purposes.
runners.comment: Fine second in the Wokingham but not at the same level back at Ascot last week

runners.name: Realign
runners.spotlight: Profile is hit and miss but conditions won't faze him; he looked good at Carlisle (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) in May and brings relatively low mileage but he was only midfield in the Wokingham and is 1lb higher today, so needs a big personal best.
runners.comment: Still relatively low mileage but he needs a clear personal best to take this

runners.name: Evening Saigon
runners.spotlight: Chased home Far Above Dream, beaten a neck with the pair clear, in a C&D handicap in May; again finished behind that rival in the Wokingham six weeks ago (cheekpieces first time) and needs more to win but that is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who has finished behind Far Above Dream on his last two starts

runners.name: Far Above Dream
runners.spotlight: Another success story for James Owen, progressing well in 2025 and continuing the good work this time around with wins over C&D and at Newbury (both good ground); another step forward when fourth in the Wokingham, an effort that can be upgraded, and he races off the same mark today; 3-3 over C&D and sure to be popular.
runners.comment: Hugely progressive sprinter, 4th in the Wokingham latest; 3-3 over C&D; major player

runners.name: King Of Light
runners.spotlight: Impressed at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; had an excuse at Ascot next time and spent the first half of the race in the unfavoured stands' side group when down the field there last week; this looks too demanding all the same.
runners.comment: Has had excuses since a Windsor win in June but others are still more persuasive

runners.name: Ferrous
runners.spotlight: Best known for his AW exploits but he is fine on turf and has a lower mark in this sphere; went desperately close at Hamilton (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago, a race in which the first two pulled clear in the closing stages from a subsequent winner; 2lb ahead of the handicapper and he was successful on his only visit to Goodwood; interesting.
runners.comment: Well treated on turf; latest Hamilton second was a fine effort; 2lb well in; interesting

runners.name: Soldier's Tree
runners.spotlight: He didn't make his debut until December but this 5yo is quickly making up for lost time, finishing third in a Listed race at Salisbury (6f, good) on his stable debut and then running a huge race in the Wokingham at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), beaten just over one length into third off a 1lb lower mark; again raced freely when third in a Group 3 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; still has potential after just six starts.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 5yo; repeat of his Wokingham third off 1lb lower would bring him right into it

runners.name: Fandom
runners.spotlight: 6f winner at Thirsk (good) in May and back at a similar level when a keeping-on third behind Dubai Bling at Ascot (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should run his race but others are perhaps better treated.
runners.comment: Good 3rd to Dubai Bling at Ascot 3 weeks ago; should run his race but others are stronger

runners.name: Dubai Bling
runners.spotlight: Would have finished closer than tenth in the Wokingham at Royal Ascot (6f) granted a clear run; scaled new heights when beating his 14 rivals there (5f, also good to firm) three weeks ago, finishing his race off strongly; 3lb wrong under his penalty today and while he has more good races in him, this one might prove too demanding.
runners.comment: Progressive but a 6lb penalty for his narrow 5f Ascot win demands another personal best

runners.name: Berkshire Whisper
runners.spotlight: He has done all his winning on AW but his fourth at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in April is a comparable standard; can win races on the grass but perhaps not this one.
runners.comment: All wins on AW; likely to prove as effective on turf in time but this looks too hot though
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Dark Thirty
runners.spotlight: Beat his 21 rivals at York in May and added a handicap at Chester (6f, good) last month; ran a fine race behind Sondad at the Curragh two weeks ago and is 7lb better off for half a length this time; officially the best handicapped horse in the race (5lb ahead of his mark) and another big run should be forthcoming.
runners.comment: 5lb ahead of his mark after a fine second in Ireland two weeks ago; should be involved

runners.name: Gold Star Hero
runners.spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; he didn't run badly off his revised mark at Epsom on Derby day but it would be a surprise if he were up to a task of this magnitude.
runners.comment: Soared up the handicap after completing AW hat-trick in the spring; this looks too tough

runners.name: Northern Champion
runners.spotlight: Two wins in Dubai early in the year before coming up short in Group 1 company in March and June; back on the up with a 7f Listed win at Chester three weeks ago; this looks a tough task under 6lb penalty though.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo but penalty for last month's 7f Listed win leaves him looking vulnerable

runners.name: Tuco Salamanca
runners.spotlight: Blessed with a potent turn of foot and he has been impressive in winning 6f AW handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle this year; a 3lb rise for the latter success five weeks ago doesn't handicap him out of things and he ran well in his one visit to Goodwood; one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Potent turn of foot on his day; still improving and he is more appealing than most in here

runners.name: Flash Harry
runners.spotlight: Still has low mileage and is proven over C&D but he has come up well short in deep races since winning here last August; hood left off this time; others look safer.
runners.comment: C&D winner; limitations exposed in good races on last three starts; hood off today

runners.name: Stratusnine
runners.spotlight: Looked one to follow when bolting up at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in December; had numerous excuses for a series of subsequent defeats but things finally clicked again at York (6f, good to firm) last week, gamely repelling 20 rivals; 2lb wrong under his penalty but he has Group-race aspirations and shouldn't be passed over lightly.
runners.comment: Game win at York latest; 2lb wrong under penalty but still has Group-race aspirations

runners.name: Two Tribes
runners.spotlight: Surged to the front 1f out when dominant in this race (good to soft) 12 months ago; 7lb higher this time around but he was better than ever when second in a hot handicap at Ascot last week (7f, good to firm) when coming from further back than ideal; 2lb ahead of the handicapper and he has a fine chance of becoming the fifth horse to win back-to-back Stewards' Cups (Commanche Falls in 2021 and 2022 was the latest).
runners.comment: Bolted up in this race last year; fine second at Ascot last week; major player

runners.name: Garfield Shadow
runners.spotlight: Won five of his ten starts for Richard Fahey, notably a local Group 3 in Qatar in November 2024; absent for 593 days and gelded prior to his stable debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month, a race in which he was caught out wide but plugged on for second behind the thriving easy winner; clearly retains ability but this will demand much more.
runners.comment: Encouraging seasonal/stable debut at Pontefract after a long absence; this is much tougher

runners.name: Invictus Gold
runners.spotlight: His impressive Newmarket success last May saw him hit hard by the handicapper and he hasn't added to it; chasing home Sondad at Epsom (6f, soft) in June represented his best run of the year but he failed to build on it at Windsor last time; others look safer.
runners.comment: Ran well behind Sondad on Derby day but that is sandwiched by two modest efforts

runners.name: Hammer The Hammer
runners.spotlight: On the up in 2025, completing a hat-trick before fine runs at Royal Ascot and in the Ayr Gold Cup (beaten favourite in this race in between); had a wind operation prior to reappearance but he has finished down the field in both starts since, the Wokingham on latest; down in the weights but a full revival is essential; tongue-tie experiment last time is quickly aborted.
runners.comment: Yet to shine in two runs this year but 2025 best would bring him right into the picture

runners.name: Toca Madera
runners.spotlight: Has a history of running well at this meeting and Tuesday's fourth (5f, good) was another solid effort; this looks a much stiffer test though.
runners.comment: Ran well over 5f here on Tuesday but this looks a stiffer test of his credentials
runners.owner: L Bond & Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi

runners.name: Mitbaahy
runners.spotlight: He hasn't had a great deal of racing since July 2024 but, two wind surgeries and a gelding operation later, he has shown he retains a good chunk of his former ability (Group 2 winner at best) this year, in a tongue-tie on last two starts; finished just behind Soldier's Tree when fifth in the Wokingham (6f, good to firm) but was in front of that rival in a Group 3 at Newbury two weeks ago; 3lb well in and has the ability to feature but his tendency to forfeit ground at the start isn't ideal in a race of this depth.
runners.comment: Group 2 winner at his best; good runs in a tongue-tie on last two starts; 3lb well in

runners.name: Sondad
runners.spotlight: Climbed the ranks as a 4yo, ending that campaign with placed efforts in the Ayr Silver Cup and at Ascot; down the field on seasonal return but he hasn't looked back since, winning at Epsom (6f, soft) on Derby day for the second year in succession, doing best of the low numbers in the Wokingham (the others in his group have done well since) and then seeing off 19 rivals at the Curragh (6.3f, good to firm) two weeks ago; showed a fantastic attitude on that latest occasion and his 6lb penalty shouldn't prevent another big performance.
runners.comment: Tough and reliable in 6f h'caps; career best in Ireland latest; big player under penalty

runners.name: Run Boy Run
runners.spotlight: Finished fourth behind stablemate Two Tribes in this race 12 months ago when 8lb lower and enjoyed his finest hour when making most to win the Ayr Gold Cup (6f, soft) last September; successful in Dubai early in the year and although his results have been mixed since returning to Britain, he retains plenty of ability; down the field over 5f here on Tuesday when a change of tactics failed to bear fruit; better can be expected today.
runners.comment: 4th here in 2025 off 8lb lower; won Ayr Gold Cup after; below best on Tuesday (held up)

runners.name: Get It
runners.spotlight: Made all up the stands' rail when springing a 40-1 surprise in this race in 2024; added another major handicap when dominating last year's Wokingham; failed to beat a rival in his next three starts though (including in this race) and he has been absent for 314 days; his draw gives him the chance to repeat the heroics of 2024 but this looks a tough assignment on his return.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2024 and the Wokingham last year; stiff task after 314-day absence

runners.name: West Acre
runners.spotlight: Quickly established himself as a smart sprinter, winning Group 2 and Group 3 prizes at Meydan (both 5f; good to firm and good) in early 2025; the addition of cheekpieces saw him return to his best when second in a 5f Group 3 on Dundalk AW last October; not quite at his best in two runs in Dubai in January and absent since; new blinkers need to have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Capable of smart form on his day; not at his best when last seen in January; now blinkered

runners.name: Annaf
runners.spotlight: Having edged down the weights he offered a good deal more when third to Tuco Salamanca at Newcastle (6f, AW) in June; finished with a flourish when seventh behind Dubai Bling at Ascot (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, a run that confirmed he was still in good order; returning to 6f will help and he can't be dismissed, for all that he has been well beaten in this race twice before (2022 and 2025).
runners.comment: Handicapped to win again; last two runs promising but well held in 2022 and 2025 runnings

runners.name: We're Goosers
runners.spotlight: Gelded since finishing last when favourite for the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m); had progressive 7f form previously and recorded a wide-margin success at Newmarket (good) the time before, taking record over this trip to 2211; may still have more to offer and remains of interest.
runners.comment: Gelded since Britannia flop; progressive 7f form previously;  may still have more to offer

runners.name: Naval Light
runners.spotlight: Took a while to hit the target but he had some notable maiden form, including at this meeting last year, and now bids for a hat-trick after wins under Jack Nicholls at Pontefract (6f maiden, good to soft) and Catterick (7f handicap; good to firm); further improvement is possible; respected.
runners.comment: Bids for a hat-trick after two wins under Jack Nicholls; further improvement is possible

runners.name: Marengo Storm
runners.spotlight: Prevailed narrowly in small field when upped to 7f at Newmarket (good to firm) last time, taking record to 2-4; goes into deeper waters but remains unexposed, particularly at this distance; wears first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Won narrowly upped to 7f at Newmarket last time, taking record to 2-4; still unexposed

runners.name: Wild Desert
runners.spotlight: The class angle in this field and has earned top weight on handicap debut, having ended his progressive 2yo season with good efforts in a Newmarket Group 2 (7f, good to firm) and Canadian Grade 1 (1m, firm); a likely danger provided he's back in similar form with Listed reappearance under his belt.
runners.comment: The class angle in this field and a likely danger with Listed reappearance under his belt

runners.name: Proud Nation
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage colt who registered his 2yo success in a York maiden and posted two sound efforts since handicapping, beaten narrowly by Ironwill at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) latest; may do better still; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Two sound efforts since handicapping, beaten narrowly by Ironwill at Newmarket latest

runners.name: Startled
runners.spotlight: Broadly progressive gelding who has form figures of 11127 in turf handicaps, the latest effort best forgiven (met trouble); ran well in a competitive field over C&D the time before; still 9lb above last winning mark but Harry Vigors takes off a useful 5lb; in the mix.
runners.comment: Latest effort is best forgiven; strong record otherwise in turf handicaps; in the mix

runners.name: Ironwill
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort who held on narrowly from Proud Nation over 7f at Newmarket (good to firm) most recently, adding to his 2yo sprint wins and taking record to 3-7; ran creditably over C&D in May; solid chance.
runners.comment: Held on narrowly from Proud Nation at Newmarket last time; has C&D form; solid chance

runners.name: Start Me Up
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 114, all at Chester (6f and around 7f), since being gelded (maiden previously); not disgraced last time but has something to prove off the same mark switched to a different venue and upped in grade.
runners.comment: Record of 114, all at Chester, since being gelded; something to prove in this scenario

runners.name: Ghost Mode
runners.spotlight: Campaigned over shorter this term, posting a useful AW win on reappearance and not disgraced at Newmarket most recently; showed respectable 7f form as a 2yo, including a good effort in the maiden on this card and a success at Chester; still fairly unexposed over this distance; interesting.
runners.comment: Returns to 7f for first time this term; still fairly unexposed over this trip; interesting

runners.name: Aqpan
runners.spotlight: Commenced career with a record of 221 on AW; far from solid on his Listed/Group form on turf since (peak effort may not be reliable) and has something to prove off his mark; gelded since last run.
runners.comment: Far from solid on turf form and has something to prove off his mark; gelded since last run

runners.name: Egoli
runners.spotlight: Won on the nod at Doncaster (good to firm) last time, looking suited by the step up to 7f and surging back to form; unexposed over this trip and may remain competitive, provided he takes to first-time cheekpieces (faced difficult task when once in blinkers).
runners.comment: Won on the nod upped to 7f last time; may remain competitive if taking to cheekpieces

runners.name: Ay Up Duck
runners.spotlight: Appears to have his limitations, being 2-2 in Class 5 but 0-5 in higher grades; gained the latest success at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last week; opposed from 6lb out of the weights in this markedly better race.
runners.comment: Success last week took his Class 5 record to 2-2; 6lb out of weights back up in grade

runners.name: Utmost Good Faith
runners.spotlight: Back in his comfort zone at Epsom (7f, good) last time, taking Class 4 record to 3-3; sold out of George Boughey's yard for 28,000gns since; returns to deeper waters off a demanding mark; new headgear.
runners.comment: Latest performance took his Class 4 record to 3-3; returns to deeper waters; new yard

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts And Geldings Only)

runners.name: Charted Course
runners.spotlight: 450,000gns breeze-up 2yo purchase who appeared to run well, despite being hampered and racing in the unfavoured group, in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (finished tenth of 25 overall, fourth of nine on the far side) in latest 6f start; one of the form players, upped in trip.
runners.comment: Seemed to run well in the Windsor Castle last time; one of the main form players

runners.name: Rafe's Da Man
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who is moving steadily in the right direction, third at Newbury (7f, good to firm) most recently; however, likely needs further progress to open his account in this field and he's the stable second string on jockey arrangements.
runners.comment: Moving in the right direction but likely needs further progress in this field

runners.name: Leadlight
runners.spotlight: Holds a Group 1 entry; has two pieces of experience, namely fourth-place finishes in Naas barrier trial and Leopardstown event (7f, good); shaped particularly well on latter occasion, finishing nicely once seeing daylight; brings potential and adds great interest.
runners.comment: Fourth in barrier trial and 7f Leopardstown event; shaped particularly well last time

runners.name: Rupert The Brave
runners.spotlight: 38,000euros foal, 70,000gns yearling; Phoenix Of Spain half-brother to Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner Rush Queen (RPR 88); dam unraced, out of maiden half-sister to Group-placed 1m 2yo winner Yaseer; begins career in rather deep waters.
runners.comment: 70,000gns yearling; by Phoenix Of Spain; begins career in rather deep waters

runners.name: Speyside
runners.spotlight: Blue Point colt; sibling to two winners, notably Wolf Of Badenoch (Group-placed 7f 2yo/1m3f; RPR 101); dam 12.4f AW/1m5f turf scorer (89), half-sister to Irish Oaks winner Even So; probably one of the better types among the newcomers.
runners.comment: Nicely bred colt who is probably one of the better types among the newcomers

runners.name: Regency Royal
runners.spotlight: Showed promise with second-place finish in 6f event at Chester while shaping as if today's extra furlong will suit; this is a stronger race but he's open to progress and could go well.
runners.comment: Showed promise at Chester while shaping as if today's extra furlong will suit

runners.name: Market Leader
runners.spotlight: 450,000euros breeze-up 2yo buy who holds two Group entries; hindered his chance with an awkward start and some greenness en route to finishing third of nine (as 4-5 favourite) over 6f at Windsor; recorded a modest RPR but should do better with the experience under his belt.
runners.comment: 4-5 when he hindered his chance with awkward start at Windsor; should be capable of better

runners.name: Speakers Corner
runners.spotlight: Ballydoyle colt who holds several Group entries; unable to quicken in steadily run maiden at the Curragh (7f, good to firm) but stuck on for fourth of six and should be capable of improvement, especially if getting a stronger pace kept to this distance; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Ballydoyle colt who should build on Curragh effort, especially if getting a stronger pace
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Dontworryaboutme
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; Awtaad half-brother to two winners, notably Endless Power (1m/9.4f AW; RPR 95); dam unraced half-sister to Oaks winner Qualify; pitched into a warm maiden on debut; likely best watched.
runners.comment: 30,000euros yearling; pitched into a warm maiden on debut; best watched

runners.name: Howzatt
runners.spotlight: Zoustar half-brother to 12 winners, notably James Garfield (6f/7f including 2yo Group 2; RPR 119); dam 6f/7f 2yo scorer (103); from a family that his connections know well; the betting may offer further guidance.
runners.comment: From a family that his connections know well; the betting may offer further guidance

runners.name: Magi Melchior
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in 6f contests, finishing fourth both times and earning a mark of 77 which is 3lb below the one allotted to stablemate Rafe's Da Man but this is the first string on jockey arrangements and still open to progress with this new trip a plus on breeding.
runners.comment: The stable first string and remains open to progress with this new trip a likely plus

runners.name: Bundaberg
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns yearling; by Australia; dam placed at 1m2f/1m3f in Germany, sibling to a few very useful German winners, notably Elle Shadow (triple 1m2f Group 3); probably one to look out for over longer trips later on.
runners.comment: 45,000gns yearling; pedigree suggests he's one to look out for over further later on

runners.name: Walkin On The Moon
runners.spotlight: Green and in rear throughout at Newmarket, finishing almost 5l behind Al Wathba; may do better with the experience under his belt but has work to do to reverse placings with that rival.
runners.comment: Finished almost 5l behind Al Wathba at Newmarket; work to do

runners.name: Crest Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Third to Blue Courvoisier in the Silver Bowl at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May and bounced back from Royal Ascot defeat (drawn on the wrong side) for clear second at Ascot (1m, good to firm), when a nose behind Ciarrai Abu who followed up here on Thursday; he should stay this far, and this progressive 3yo could be on an advantageous mark up 4lb since last time.
runners.comment: The form of his near miss at Ascot last time was franked by the winner here on Thursday

runners.name: Point Of Contact
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who took a step forward to win in a big field at York (1m1f, good) in June; more than just the extra furlong was to blame for his disappointing run at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) since, but he retains potential and it will be no surprise to see a big performance.
runners.comment: 1m1f win in big field at York in June; disappointing since but retains potential

runners.name: Real Gain
runners.spotlight: Third of 15 for Richard Hughes in the Golden Mile here last August when 5lb higher; hasn't hit the same heights since, most recently fifth of nine at Redcar when the 6-4 favourite; however, he's on a dangerous mark and is not written off; interesting to see if he's again strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Needs to raise his game but he's on a dangerous mark on his form here 12 months ago

runners.name: Spell Master
runners.spotlight: Close third at Newmarket (good) in June on his first crack at 1m and second start for this yard, and he made good headway before his run petered out in the John Smith's Cup at York (10.2f, good to firm), finishing sixth of 22; has won here and today's drop back in trip/grade could prove ideal.
runners.comment: Made promising headway in the John Smith's Cup before run petered out; contender

runners.name: Shafdar
runners.spotlight: 4yo who was making his seventh start when winning at Epsom (8.5f, good) in April; two lesser runs have followed but it wasn't a bad effort at Sandown last time and the fact he excelled at Epsom bodes well for today's first visit to Goodwood, which has similarities; wears a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Below best on last two starts but previous Epsom win bodes well for first Goodwood visit

runners.name: Thinthread
runners.spotlight: Two-time French winner who could improve from his British debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) last month, when fifth of seven; dropped 2lb but there's a suspicion he remains on a tough mark; wears first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Two-time French winner; fifth of seven on British debut; suspicion he's on a tough mark

runners.name: Blue Courvoisier
runners.spotlight: Built upon previous promise to win the Silver Bowl at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May on his third handicap start; mid-division in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) since when fifth of 15 on the unfavoured far side; this 3yo remains of interest and is firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Won the Silver Bowl at Carlisle then midfield at Royal Ascot; this 3yo remains of interest

runners.name: El Matador
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who was runner-up on his first two starts this season (7f/1m, AW/good) and has been a good third on his last two outings (1m2f/1m, good/AW); there's every chance he'll be in the mix.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who has been placed on all four starts this season; can be in the mix

runners.name: Boyfriend
runners.spotlight: Fifth of 16 in this last year in a race that favoured those ridden more prominently and he's been in career-best form at Sandown on his last two starts, posting a win (1m, good) and a very creditable third of 12 (1m2f, good); could be involved.
runners.comment: Career-best form at Sandown on his last two starts and he could be involved

runners.name: Ammes
runners.spotlight: Kept on for second at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in April and he's run well in fourth on both starts since (1m2f/1m4f, good to soft/good to firm); he's never raced over a trip this short and it isn't an obvious plus, but on the flip-side a well-run race in this big field should play to his strengths.
runners.comment: He's never raced over a trip this short but a well-run race should play to his strengths

runners.name: Sweet Reward
runners.spotlight: 9yo who won two in a row at Lingfield (1m2f/1m1f, good to firm) and maybe went off too hard when well beaten at Sandown (1m2f, good) last time; has won here twice and he might not be far away if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Two-time course winner; won two in a row at Lingfield in May; went off hard at Sandown

runners.name: Great Chieftain
runners.spotlight: Course winner who won two in a row last May (1m, good) and is 4lb below his last winning mark; showed some spark at Meydan in January but hasn't shone in Britain on his two runs since and needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Course winner who is 4lb below his last winning mark but needs to turn things around

runners.name: Thunder Wonder
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent and his losing sequence is up to 11 races; however, he was a close third off this reduced mark at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) last time and is an each-way contender if backing up that performance.
runners.comment: Inconsistent but close third at Musselburgh last time; each-way claims if backing that up

runners.name: First Ambition
runners.spotlight: 5yo who won last year on first two starts before good second on handicap debut at Haydock where he was 7lb higher; however, his form has gone the wrong way since and there was no revival on last month's stable debut.
runners.comment: 5yo who made a promising start to career last year but his form has gone the wrong way

runners.name: Nostrum
runners.spotlight: Extremely well handicapped on his old form; it appeared to bode very well for this campaign when he was runner-up at Sandown in May on his second stable start, but he's failed to kick on and has something to prove.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Sandown in May, which boded very well, but he's failed to kick on since

runners.name: Alcaraz
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner in France; this front-runner was runner-up in twice in a row for Tom Dascombe last July/September but things didn't go to plan on his final two runs for that yard (Flat/hurdles) and he was well beaten on his stable and seasonal debut at Chepstow in May.
runners.comment: Some good form last year but well beaten on stable/seasonal debut this May

runners.name: Rock Of Cashel
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle 4yo who has been running for Norwegian yard this year; won in Norway in May but struggled in handicaps at Meydan early this year and was well beaten in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot in June (third of six in far-side group); others are preferred.
runners.comment: Won in Norway in May but well beaten in Meydan/Royal Ascot handicaps either side of that

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Orionis
runners.spotlight: Best effort when winning Goodwood handicap (1m4f, good) in May; respectable third in C&D Listed race two weeks ago, racing freely and finding no extra; may not have reached her ceiling just yet and she's high on the list.
runners.comment: Respectable third in C&D Listed race two weeks ago; may not have reached ceiling just yet

runners.name: Francophone
runners.spotlight: Useful on her day; highly tried and not at best so far this year, but she ran respectably when never-nearer fourth of eight in Irish Group 3 (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; moves into unknown territory trip-wise but her pedigree gives hope that she'll stay and this is a drop in grade.
runners.comment: Highly tried and not at best this year but is now down in grade; should stay longer trip

runners.name: Romantic Symphony
runners.spotlight: Won her first two races; disappointing when favourite for Lingfield Oaks Trial in the spring but firmly back on track when second in French Listed event (1m4f, good; collared late on after being clear over 1f out) six weeks ago; still has untapped potential.
runners.comment: Firmly back on track when second in French Listed event; still has untapped potential

runners.name: Revoir
runners.spotlight: From a family that has served these connections well; 0-10 since her debut success but she finished close behind Orionis when fifth in C&D Listed race (7-4 favourite) last time; previous two efforts read even better and she's a major player with a visor replacing cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Close fifth when favourite for C&D Listed race last time; major player in first-time visor

runners.name: Miss Justice
runners.spotlight: Listed winner and Group 3 runner-up for the Gosdens last year; has shown she retains all her ability, fourth in Group 2 over C&D (good to firm; wore tongue-strap) last month; this is easier and she should be thereabouts in a first-time hood.
runners.comment: Fourth in C&D Group 2; this is easier and she should be thereabouts in first-time hood

runners.name: Gone By
runners.spotlight: Has improved with each run this year, winning maiden at Ripon (1m3f, good) and handicap at Salisbury (1m4f, good to firm; dug deep to see off main challenger by a neck), both in small fields; this is a sterner assignment but she's still unexposed and in good hands.
runners.comment: Progressive; up in grade but arrives on a hat-trick and must be considered

runners.name: Sunshine Star
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars half-sister to the same connections' Oaks winner Soul Sister; arrives on an upward curve after easy novice win at Lingfield and unlucky second in handicap at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm; stayed on well after being short of room); plenty to find on bare form in this higher grade but she should be well suited by this step up in trip and cannot be discounted.
runners.comment: Plenty to find on bare form but arrives on upward curve and cannot be discounted

runners.name: Orchard Keeper
runners.spotlight: Reliable type whose wins have come in 1m2f and 1m6f handicaps; good fourth on her only attempts at Listed company but she'll need a personal best if she's to make a winning reappearance after ten months off.
runners.comment: Reliable; will need personal best to make winning reappearance after ten months off

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Havana Sprite
runners.spotlight: Green on debut but hasn't looked back since and she forced a dead-heat in C&D Listed race (good to firm; 100-30) last time; may have more in the tank and she's high on the list once more.
runners.comment: Dead-heated in C&D Listed race last time; progressive and high on the list once more

runners.name: Donegal Rose
runners.spotlight: Got up late on to win maiden at Chester (5.5f, good) in May but ran poorly when upped to 7f for nursery there two months later; perhaps this intermediate trip will suit but she's on a retrieval mission.
runners.comment: On a retrieval mission after poor run in nursery at Chester three weeks ago

runners.name: Fire Thunder
runners.spotlight: Gained deserved win after three second places in maiden at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago, no more than workmanlike in landing the odds; in deeper here and 3lb out of weights but she may not be fully exposed.
runners.comment: Gained deserved win in maiden at Lingfield; in deeper here but may not be fully exposed

runners.name: Lady Dublin
runners.spotlight: Has taken off for front-running tactics and cheekpieces on her last two starts, winning nurseries at Catterick and Thirsk (both 6f, good to firm); up 11lb in total but keeps improving and should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Thriving for positive tactics and cheekpieces, winning twice; another bold bid expected

runners.name: Rollthedicebaby
runners.spotlight: Could finish only in midfield in the Super Sprint at Newbury (4-1) last month but she was done no favours by the draw; better judged on a clearcut maiden win at Goodwood (6f, soft) the time before; remains open to improvement and may well get back on track here.
runners.comment: Done no favours by draw in the Super Sprint; clearcut winner the time before; respected

runners.name: Holi Scarlett
runners.spotlight: Like Rollthedicebaby, she finished in mid-division in the Super Sprint (80-1) last time, but she had no excuses on account of the draw; up against it here from 4lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Mid-division in Super Sprint last time; up against it here from 4lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Love A Giggle
runners.spotlight: Down the field in the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot, but she'd previously come from the rear to win the Listed Marygate at York (5f, good); should be just as effective over 6f and may still have untapped potential.
runners.comment: No show at Royal Ascot but had previously won York Listed race; may still be unexposed

runners.name: Glamorize
runners.spotlight: Improving with each run and won going away from two rivals in nursery at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago; raised 5lb but should be well suited by this return to 6f and may well complete a hat-trick.
runners.comment: Won going away from two rivals at Nottingham; improving and may well complete hat-trick

runners.name: Acclamation Star
runners.spotlight: Highly tried since debut win at Bath (5.7f, firm) in May; seemed to show improvement when sixth of eight in C&D Group 2 three weeks ago, although 50-1 and no threat; that run hasn't been missed by the handicapper.
runners.comment: No threat in C&D Group 2 three weeks ago; down in grade but has gone up 9lb for that

races.race_name: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Kiah
runners.spotlight: Quite stoutly bred and predictably improved for the step up to 7f when third here (good to firm; 33-1) two weeks ago; the type to progress with racing and should be involved in the shake-up once more.
runners.comment: Third here two weeks ago; the type to progress with racing and should be in the mix again

runners.name: Haleema
runners.spotlight: By Frankel; sister to 1m3f/2m2f Flat (RPR 84) and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Secret Force, half-sister to 7f winner Cerro Blanco (103); dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/Listed; 107), out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winner; stable won this race in 2017, 2020 and 2024 and has a strike-rate of over 40% with its 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Daughter of Frankel; top stable has a strike-rate of over 40% with its 2yos this season

runners.name: Asheyra
runners.spotlight: 380,000gns yearling; by Dark Angel; dam 5f/5.5f winner (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 99), half-sister to 5f-6f winner Marching Mac, out of 1m winning half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Muthabara; expensive purchase with a useful pedigree and representing a leading local yard.
runners.comment: Expensive purchase with a useful pedigree and representing a leading local yard

runners.name: Spirited Gesture
runners.spotlight: By Kingman; sister to winners Calyx (6f including 2yo Group 2; RPR 118), Coppice (7f/1m including 2yo/Listed; 117) and Stanage (7f; 92); dam 6f-1m 2yo winner (including Group 3; 112), sister to 6f Group 1 winner African Rose; has an excellent Juddmonte pedigree and her stable's 2yos are just beginning to fire; big player on paper.
runners.comment: Has an excellent Juddmonte pedigree and her stable's 2yos are just beginning to fire

runners.name: Give Me A Bow
runners.spotlight: By Stradivarius; dam placed 7f 2yo (RPR 70), half-sister to useful winners Not Never (1m1f 2yo/1m4f Flat and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Final Watch (7f); may be of more interest in the longer term.
runners.comment: Newcomer by Stradivarius; may be of more interest in the longer term

runners.name: Jessica
runners.spotlight: 200,000euros yearling; Coulsty half-sister to winners Pierre Bonnard (1m/1m2f 2yo including Group 1; RPR 119), Crepe Suzette (Group-placed 9.4f; 110) and Diavolo (7f; 91); dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Group 1 Nassau Stakes; 116); has a classy pedigree; stable's 2yos operating at 19% this season.
runners.comment: 200,000euros yearling; has a classy pedigree; stable's 2yos operating at 19% this season

runners.name: Phillipa
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and always behind both starts; may benefit from today's step up in distance but needs a giant leap forward.
runners.comment: Always behind both starts; may benefit from step up in trip but needs a giant leap forward

runners.name: Hardy's Hero
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten on three of his four starts since being gelded, going down on the nod at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) on latest; should go close again off an unchanged mark, especially if first-time headgear has a positive effect.
runners.comment: Narrowly beaten on three of four starts since being gelded; should go close again

runners.name: Lion Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Likeable 7f specialist (all four wins at this trip); just edged out by Sierra Sands over C&D three weeks ago; holding his form really well and should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Likeable 7f specialist; just edged out by Sierra Sands here last time; in the mix again

runners.name: Spirit Of Saxony
runners.spotlight: Unlucky over this trip at Sandown two outings ago from just 1lb lower, but was disappointing when only fourth there next time; hasn't had much racing and may get back on the up.
runners.comment: Disappointing last time but unlucky two outings ago; lightly raced; may get back on the up

runners.name: Sierra Sands
runners.spotlight: Thriving on this course this summer, and beat Lion Of Mali a neck over C&D three weeks ago; edging up the weights only slowly and should give another good account of himself.
runners.comment: Beat Lion Of Mali a neck over C&D; should give another good account of himself

runners.name: Tryst
runners.spotlight: Campaigned over as far as 10.3f but proved well suited by the drop back to 7f when winning in clearcut style at Yarmouth (good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) last month; now that connections have found the key, she's open to further improvement; leading contender.
runners.comment: Proved well suited by drop back to 7f when winning at Yarmouth; leading contender

runners.name: Electrical
runners.spotlight: Sprang a 25-1 upset on debut at Newbury (6f) last summer, but unplaced all outings since, including over 1m4f last time; plummeting in the weights but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Unplaced all outings since successful debut; plummeting in the weights but hard to fancy

runners.name: Divine Knight
runners.spotlight: 5yo now who won for Sean Woods on belated debut last July; no joy in his seven races since, three for this yard, but he kept on well for a good third of 12 in a slowly run race at Ayr (upped markedly to 1m5f, soft) in June and may well have been stretched by 1m6f when performing respectably at Ascot (good to firm; made most) three weeks ago; firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Sole win (eight races) was debut but last two performances put him firmly in the mix

runners.name: Sixpack
runners.spotlight: Has done well over 1m4f-1m6f on turf this term, winning three times from six starts; latest win came easily at this track (1m6f, good to firm) in June and he's 7lb higher today; tailing off so badly at Southwell four weeks ago may be offputting but he came last in 2025 in his only other AW race, so perhaps can spring back to life with today's return to turf.
runners.comment: Has done well over 1m4f-1m6f on turf this term, so perhaps best to forgive AW run latest

runners.name: First Officer
runners.spotlight: Often ridden by claimer Alexandra Egan, including when he won a four-runner C&D race (good to firm) last July off the same mark as today; creditable second on last two outings (C&D latest) suggest he will be bang there.
runners.comment: Creditable second on last two outings (C&D latest) suggest he will be bang there

runners.name: Way Of Life
runners.spotlight: He's had a long career but never been better than this season, winning on AW at Wolverhampton (9.4f) and Lingfield (1m4f); they were in March/April but he returned from a break with creditable third of six here (1m2f, good to firm) 15 days ago, again under Olivia Tubb; probably not far away.
runners.comment: Never better than this season; creditable third of six here (good to firm) 15 days ago

runners.name: Almekarem
runners.spotlight: Both wins (from nine races) have been in small fields, including from off the pace at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance ten days ago; going back up 4lb demands more but there's a fair chance that he'll turn out to be an improved performer this term; up 2f, which he's not sure to stay, but he has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Won recent reappearance; up 2f, which he's not sure to stay, but he's on the shortlist

runners.name: Arqoob
runners.spotlight: Gained his most recent win here (1m6f) last August off 2lb lower in first-time blinkers; with creditable shows in two of his three starts this season, he is firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Won here (1m6f) last August; creditable shows in two of his three starts this season

runners.name: Greek Order
runners.spotlight: Has some back-class but now 0-11 for this yard and the form he showed in initial outings last summer has not been repeated; accelerating down the weights, which gives him a chance on this year's form even, but others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Accelerating down the weights (chance on 2026 form even) but others are more convincing
runners.owner: S Mizon, H McAlpine & Winner Racing Ltd

runners.name: Haku
runners.spotlight: Ten-time AW winner who is 5lb lower than when winning at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last November; however, this is his first run since January and he was well beaten at Ascot in May 2024 on his last encounter with turf; 0-5 on grass and others have less to prove.
runners.comment: Off since January; well beaten at Ascot in May 2024 on his last encounter with turf

runners.name: Food For Thought
runners.spotlight: Has taken a while to get the hang of things, but improved form last two starts, winning novice in small field at Nottingham and pulling clear with the winner when second in handicap at Salisbury (both 1m2f, good to firm); tactically versatile and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Improved form last two starts; tactically versatile and looks the one to beat
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Thaluna
runners.spotlight: 6f winner last autumn; has been running respectably in 7f/1m handicaps without looking ahead of her mark; now moves up in distance (sister won up to 1m2f); should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Has been running respectably in 7f/1m handicaps without looking ahead of her mark

runners.name: Valkyrie Storm
runners.spotlight: Two wins from ten outings, both over the extended 1m at Nottingham; faded on first attempt at 1m2f when fifth at Windsor last time; beginning to look exposed.
runners.comment: Faded on first attempt at 1m2f when fifth at Windsor last time; beginning to look exposed

runners.name: Hollywell Stream
runners.spotlight: 280,000gns purchase as a yearling; hasn't gone on as anticipated from a promising debut, fading and beating only one home in maiden at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still early days but she has something to prove.
runners.comment: Hasn't built as expected on promising debut; beat just one home last time; bit to prove

runners.name: Sound And Vision
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; sole win came over this trip at Southwell last winter, and she shaped nicely after six months off on turf debut at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; now fitted with a tongue-strap; big player if building on her last run.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; shaped nicely on turf debut at Nottingham; big player if building on that

runners.name: Dottie Diamond
runners.spotlight: Missed 2025 but is making up for lost time and completed a hat-trick of 5f handicaps at Salisbury (good to firm) 11 days ago; thriving and may not have reached her limit just yet.
runners.comment: Completed hat-trick at Salisbury 11 days ago; may not have reached her limit just yet

runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: Tough 5f performer, holding his form well; close third under regular rider Chloe Lyons at Windsor on Monday; should give it his best shot again.
runners.comment: Tough 5f performer, holding his form well; should give it his best shot again

runners.name: Tuscan Point
runners.spotlight: Started well for this yard but seems to have gone off the boil, safely held when fourth over C&D two weeks ago; needs a revival.
runners.comment: Seems to have gone off the boil, safely held when fourth two weeks ago; needs a revival

runners.name: Angel Summer
runners.spotlight: 0-7; never dangerous when sixth of 11 on stable debut at Windsor (5f, good to firm) on Monday, finishing three places behind Merrimack; however, she did meet trouble that day and can't be ruled out entirely.
runners.comment: 0-7; met some trouble on stable debut at Windsor on Monday; not ruled out entirely

runners.name: Silky Robin
runners.spotlight: 0-7 on the AW between September and April, but he has won his last five races on turf; patiently ridden as usual and led late at Brighton (5f, good to firm) six weeks ago; edging up the weights only slowly and in the mix once more.
runners.comment: Has won last five races on turf, including at Brighton six weeks ago; in the mix once more

races.race_name: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Battle Fever
runners.spotlight: Never looked like getting to Palm Reader when second at Beverley (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; no improvement for stepping up to 6f at Hamilton two weeks ago; 7lb turnaround in the weights may be insufficient to turn the tables.
runners.comment: Second to the reopposing Palm Reader on debut; 7lb weights turnaround perhaps insufficient

runners.name: Palm Reader
runners.spotlight: Cost 160,000euros at the breeze-ups in May; justified favouritism with a front-running success at Beverley (5f, good to firm; Battle Fever second) four weeks ago; more to come and he's the one to beat.
runners.comment: 160,000euros breezer who created a good impression at Beverley last month; the one to beat
runners.owner: Unique Retreats, P Morrall & J Blackburn

runners.name: Red Blue Point
runners.spotlight: 92,000gns yearling; second foal; half-brother to 7f AW winner Espona Bay (RPR 71); dam 5f 2yo winner (89), half-sister to 7f winners Bendy Spirit and The Toff; stable operating at a healthy strike-rate with 2yos this season; betting useful.
runners.comment: 92,000gns half-brother to 7f AW winner Espona Bay (RPR 71); betting instructive

runners.name: Bacha
runners.spotlight: Never in the hunt in a 5f novice at Newcastle five weeks ago (18-1); should do much better at some point.
runners.comment: Never in the hunt on June's debut (5f, AW); bred to do much better in time

runners.name: River Jordan
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 5f maidens 98 days apart (gelded after debut); improvement essential.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 5f maidens 98 days apart (gelded after debut); improvement essential

runners.name: Articulate
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two 5f runs last month; minor nurseries beckon.
runners.comment: Down the field in two 5f runs last month; minor nurseries beckon

runners.name: Suenicora Star
runners.spotlight: 150-1 when finishing down the field on last week's Newcastle debut (6f, AW); needs a big step forward.
runners.comment: Down the field on last week's debut (6f, AW; 150-1); plenty more needed

runners.name: Unbeatable Fame
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and always in rear on his debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; best watched.
runners.comment: 33-1 and always in rear on his debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Jeddaal
runners.spotlight: Sole 3yo in this field; maiden last term; gelded prior to posting form figures of 131 (over 7f-1m) this season, the wins on sharp, left-handed tracks, namely Catterick (good) and Chester (good to soft); open to further improvement, should take well to Thirsk and receives weight all round; respected.
runners.comment: Record of 131 since being gelded; open to further improvement; receives weight all round

runners.name: Mirsky
runners.spotlight: Useful on his day and has a record of 2-3 over C&D, notably a success off current mark in this year's Thirsk Hunt Cup; not particularly solid on form elsewhere since but the return to this scenario may have a positive effect; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Record of 2-3 over C&D features a win off current mark in this year's Thirsk Hunt Cup

runners.name: Dosman
runners.spotlight: Generally in good form, mostly on AW, for current stable and latest effort is best forgiven (race didn't pan out favourably); not disgraced in most recent turf attempt but is still seeking a first success in this sphere and is somewhat hostage to fortune the way he races.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in most recent turf attempt but is still seeking first win in this sphere

runners.name: Mr Swivell
runners.spotlight: Scored twice in 2024 and three times in 2025; gradually back to form this season, creditable second in useful handicap at York (1m) most recently; appears to be on his way to regaining the winning thread and looks a must for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Gradually back to form this season, creditable second at York most recently; in the mix

runners.name: Northern Express
runners.spotlight: Nosed ahead in the final strides at York (7f) last time, ending a two-year losing spell and showing he retains plenty of ability aged eight; back up just 2lb he remains well treated on historical data; won the Thirsk Hunt Cup over C&D in 2023; should remain competitive.
runners.comment: Nosed ahead in final strides at York last time; won the Thirsk Hunt Cup over C&D in 2023

runners.name: Priapos
runners.spotlight: Front-running tactics backfired at the Newmarket July festival last time when bidding for a 1m hat-trick after Class 4 wins at Carlisle; remains on career-high mark and is upped further in grade, so needs to resume his improvement.
runners.comment: Remains on career-high mark and is upped further in class; needs to resume progress

runners.name: Dain Ma Nut In
runners.spotlight: Formerly a miler but has gained last three wins over 1m2f, the most recent in Bahrain; well held in major handicap returned to home soil last time; bit to prove off current mark back down in trip; Lexie Clarkson claims 7lb but has limited experience.
runners.comment: Formerly a miler but has gained last three wins over 1m2f; bit to prove back down in trip

runners.name: Sterling Knight
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at the Newmarket tracks this term, winning in May and respectable third last time; has shown versatility in the past but looks weighted to the hilt off current mark and this step back up in class adds to the difficulty.
runners.comment: Looks weighted to the hilt off current mark and this is a step back up in class to boot

runners.name: Pure Legend
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-11 in France for Henri-Francois Devin, most recently prevailing narrowly in big-field handicap at Longchamp in May; sold for 80,000euros since; likely faces a stiffer task off opening British mark but market support should be heeded.
runners.comment: Won handicap at Longchamp on final French start; stiffer task off opening British mark

runners.name: Witch Hunter
runners.spotlight: Formerly smart but is currently out of sorts, as several duck eggs next to his name reflect, and hasn't scored on turf for nearly three years (gained last two wins on Newcastle AW); opposed.
runners.comment: Formerly smart but is currently out of sorts; hasn't won on turf for three years

runners.name: Tuscan Hills
runners.spotlight: Commenced career with two wins, including Listed; 0-6 and patchy form-wise since but proved resurgent in York handicap (1m; debut for new stable) most recently and is interesting off current mark assuming he builds on that effort.
runners.comment: Proved resurgent last time (stable debut); interesting assuming he builds on that effort

races.race_name: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Brighton Beach
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise in both starts, even when last of three at Chester (1m2f, good) last month (runner-up has won since); shortlisted for stable that took this in 2022 and 2023.
runners.comment: Has shown promise in both starts; shortlisted for stable that took this in 2022 and 2023

runners.name: Regal Desire
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in both starts, looking unlucky not to win having been badly hampered at Beverley (8.5f, good) last time; major player.
runners.comment: Runner-up in both starts, looking unlucky not to win last time; major player

runners.name: Le Samourai
runners.spotlight: 450,000gns yearling; disappointing when sent off favourite for his Salisbury debut (7f, soft) in June, but with a tongue-tie fitted he showed his true colours when winning a Kempton novice (7f, AW) last month; has a 7lb penalty to carry, but bred to be smart so could easily step forward again.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Kempton last month; bred to be smart so could easily step forward again

runners.name: Test Run
runners.spotlight: Offered promise when fourth of ten in a Doncaster maiden (1m, soft) on his debut September, but well held on his Hamilton return (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago; looks one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Promise in one start as a 2yo, but well held on his reappearance; looks one for handicaps

runners.name: Morty Robinson
runners.spotlight: Sent off 100-1 when beaten miles into last of 13 on his Southwell debut (7f, AW) nine days ago; stable runs three.
runners.comment: Beaten miles into last of 13 on his Southwell debut nine days ago

runners.name: Ben Travato
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when a well-beaten last of six on his Redcar debut (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago; hood worn then now removed.
runners.comment: Finished a well-beaten last of six on his Redcar debut 13 days ago

runners.name: West Sleekburn Lad
runners.spotlight: Huge prices and failed to beat a rival in his first two starts (7f/1m2f) eight months apart; handicaps beckon.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in his first two starts eight months apart; handicaps beckon

runners.name: Rotokura Belle
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins this year and she ran her best race so far when third of 12 at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; races off the same mark here and should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Better than ever when third of 12 at York three weeks ago; solid claims off the same mark

runners.name: Tiva
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f handicap off this mark at Newmarket (good to firm) last August; she has run some fair races this year but her latest effort (tried in cheekpieces, usual visor back on today) wasn't one of them; no surprise to see her bounce back quickly.
runners.comment: Back to last winning mark; quiet latest but earlier efforts bring her into the reckoning

runners.name: American Bay
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; below par in a big field at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but plenty of form this season that makes him of interest; Jack Callan's claim a bonus; one to consider back at 5f.
runners.comment: C&D winner; below par over 6f last time; should go well back at 5f

runners.name: Moulin Booj
runners.spotlight: Successful off this mark at Wolverhampton in March; solid efforts on his last three starts and he should make a bold bid to win this race for the second season in succession.
runners.comment: Won this race 12 months ago; scored off this mark on AW in March; contender

runners.name: Comic Strip
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly at Windsor in May but that run is sandwiched by two lesser turf runs; connections now turn to a tongue tie and cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Mixed record on turf this summer; new accessories need to give him a lift

runners.name: Mondammej
runners.spotlight: Talented veteran but has temperament to match his ability; no turf win since 2021 and when second at Nottingham 11 days ago there were only four runners; more minor money perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Second at Nottingham 11 days ago but only four ran; no turf win since 2021

runners.name: Canaria Queen
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 5f handicaps this year, the latest off 6lb lower last month; another good effort when second over 6f here last week; likely vulnerable in Class 4.
runners.comment: Having a good year and ran well here last week (6f); vulnerable in Class 4 though

runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Wasn't winning out of turn when taking a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton in May; didn't get the clearest run at Chester three weeks ago but that took his turf record to 0-11; others are more appealing.
runners.comment: 0-11 on turf and looks high in the weights on grass

runners.name: Rock Of England
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; thriving this season, winning three of his last five starts with the latest a cosy success at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 4lb but he needs serious consideration; stable also runs American Bay.
runners.comment: Won three of his last five starts; creeping up weights but still a key player; yard run 2

runners.name: Castan
runners.spotlight: 5f AW win in April; ran well at Ripon (5f, good) later that month but he has struggled twice since; has a C&D win on his record but others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner; not at his best on his last two starts; needs a revival

runners.name: Accrual
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on this winter's AW form but he has gone off the boil more recently; given a chance by the handicapper as a consequence and he needs a market check starting out for Ruth Carr (sold out of David Loughnane's stable for 22,000gns last month).
runners.comment: Off the boil more recently but potentially well handicapped ahead of this stable debut
runners.owner: Miss K Padgett And Mrs S D Pearson

runners.name: Muker
runners.spotlight: Has a couple of C&D wins on his record; not found his best form this year and he has too much to prove for comfort, for all he is tumbling down the weights.
runners.comment: Tumbling down the weights but this two-time C&D winner has generally struggled this year

runners.name: Asuka
runners.spotlight: Impressive on 2yo debut in 2024 (6f, good) then absent until last month, when going very close at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) before easy win at 1-50 at Lingfield (6f, good to firm); could be on a good mark for this first handicap.
runners.comment: Very lightly raced 4yo who has shown considerable promise and could be on a good mark
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Andesite
runners.spotlight: Ran really well when runner-up in two big-field handicaps at York (7f/1m, good) in June; not at the same level when mid-division there (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained) but can be in the shake-up if swiftly rediscovering his previous form.
runners.comment: Twice runner-up at York in June; not at same level there last time but could bounce back

runners.name: King's School
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner, the latest at Newcastle (7f) in May, and good second at Chester (7f, good to soft) in June; however, only fifth of ten at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last time and has to leave that run behind if he's to get off the mark on turf at the seventh attempt.
runners.comment: Won on Newcastle AW then runner-up at Chester, but only fifth at Doncaster last time

runners.name: Angel Hunter
runners.spotlight: Won at Lingfield (1m, AW) in April and achieved his best result of this turf season when close fourth of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Achieved best result of turf season when 4th of 17 at York latest; might not be far away

runners.name: New Image
runners.spotlight: Won four times in 2024; just two runs last year and reappeared this April with close third at Redcar; down to a dangerous mark but he hasn't really shone on his last four starts and has to turn things around.
runners.comment: Down to a dangerous mark but he hasn't really shone on his last four starts

runners.name: Croupier
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his form up to June 2023 but he was then absent until this season and hasn't been the force of old on his three runs in 2026.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on 2023 form but hasn't been the same force this season after absence

runners.name: Aurora Majesty
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on final outing last season and same story on reappearance at Epsom on Oaks day (pulled hard); he has something to prove but that latest outing may have got the freshness out of him and he's on a handy mark on last season's best efforts; not written off.
runners.comment: Well beaten (pulled hard) on reappearance but on a handy mark and not written off

runners.name: Brighton Boy
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May and close second at Chester (7f, good) a fortnight later; respectable sixth of 19 at York (7f, good) next time and perhaps unsuited by return to AW most recently; each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Some good turf form in May/June & perhaps unsuited by AW recently; each-way possibilities

runners.name: Enola Grey
runners.spotlight: She's dropped below her last winning mark and has run some reasonable races on turf this summer, but without suggesting a win is imminent; she's just 1-20 on grass as opposed to 6-43 on AW.
runners.comment: Below last winning mark but not shaping as though a win is imminent; just 1-20 on turf

runners.name: Yankee Dude
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced since winning two 2yo novice races in autumn 2024 (7f, AW); returned from another absence at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in April, having been gelded, and ran well in second of six; could have part to play.
runners.comment: Very lightly raced 4yo; ran well in April after another absence; could have a part to play

runners.name: Glenfinnan
runners.spotlight: Won at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) in May and has run well in defeat at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) and Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) on his last two starts; he's in with an each-way chance.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley in May and has run well in defeat on his last two starts; each-way chance

runners.name: Woodstock
runners.spotlight: Without a win since August 2024 but he's been in good form since this visor went on, bumping into an unexposed 3yo when second of four at Catterick (7f, good to firm) and again finishing runner-up at Chester (7.5f, good) last time; in each-way calculations once more.
runners.comment: Without a win since August 2024 but runner-up on both starts since this visor went on

runners.name: Obelix
runners.spotlight: Won in fields of a similar size to today's at York (7f, good) last July and Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in June; outside of those wins his form figures since last June read 000089055 and he's a type who needs everything to drop right, but it's possible that will happen off an expected good pace today.
runners.comment: The type who needs everything to drop right but that might happen off a good pace today
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Our Havana
runners.spotlight: Reappeared at York (7f, good) in June following a wind op and he beat 19 rivals to win; very much of interest based on that performance but he was well beaten back at York (7f, good to firm) last time; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Reappeared with big-field win at York in June but well beaten there since

runners.name: It Just Takes Time
runners.spotlight: 8yo who was knocking on the door prior to making all in fine style at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) 12 days ago; had just three rivals to beat last time and he's 4lb higher in a tougher race today, but is clearly in good heart and is a two-time winner at Thirsk; could go well.
