runners.comment: Beat just three rivals when winning at Beverley but did it in fine style; in good heart

races.race_name: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap

runners.name: La Peregrina
runners.spotlight: Improved form the last twice, finishing first past the post at Goodwood (1m4f; demoted to second for causing interference) then beaten only a neck at Newbury (1m5f); respected.
runners.comment: First past the post at Goodwood then ran well at Newbury; respected in current form

runners.name: Ludo's Landing
runners.spotlight: Exposed 6yo who concedes weight to 3yo rivals but brings positives, being the only C&D scorer in the field and a winner off 2lb higher in most recent attempt in this grade.
runners.comment: The only C&D scorer in the field and successful in most recent attempt in this grade

runners.name: Northern Brave
runners.spotlight: Novice win last October; has come up well short in Class 4 handicaps this term (modest fourth last time; gelded since) but may fare better off a reduced mark at this lower level.
runners.comment: Has come up short in Class 4 handicaps this term; this is a drop back in grade

runners.name: That Darn Cantor
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has two standout pieces of form, including creditable effort with cheekpieces fitted at Doncaster (1m4f) last time; could go well in the retained headgear.
runners.comment: Ran creditably with cheekpieces fitted last time; could go well in the retained headgear

runners.name: Great
runners.spotlight: Narrowly bounced back to winning form under Jonathan England at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month, but met traffic when fifth of ten at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 11 days later; a player granted better luck.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle last month but met trouble at Beverley last time; a player

runners.name: Maldevious
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far on a few occasions in the spring, but now 0-12 and cheekpieces made no difference last time; needs the addition of a tongue-tie to make a difference.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on a few occasions in the spring, but now 0-12; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Fanjove
runners.spotlight: Both wins came on the AW last autumn; 1lb lower than for the latest, but he has beaten just one rival in four starts on turf; blinkers removed after one use and are replaced by cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Both wins came on the AW; has beaten just one rival in four starts on turf; cheekpieces on
runners.owner: P C J Dalby & R D Schuster

runners.name: Kings Merchant
runners.spotlight: 2-6 over C&D; ended a 17-race losing run at Chester (7f, good) last month and only beaten just over 2l into fourth of eight at Catterick (7f, good to firm) ten days ago; shouldn't have an issue with the return to this trip and shortlisted.
runners.comment: 2-6 over C&D and won at Chester last month; shouldn't have an issue with the return to 6f

runners.name: Mecca's Symphony
runners.spotlight: 0-9; 33-1 when second of 11 at Redcar (7f, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) in May, but ran poorly over the same C&D the following month; has questions to answer back in trip; stable also runs Lord Abama.
runners.comment: 0-9; second at Redcar in May but poor there next time; questions to answer back in trip

runners.name: Northcliff
runners.spotlight: Very disappointing at Ascot (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago which needs forgiving, but his Chepstow success (7f, good to firm) in May was the only occasion he has dropped into Class 6 company in more than two years; worth a second look.
runners.comment: Chepstow success in May was his only run in Class 6 company in more than two years

runners.name: Lord Abama
runners.spotlight: Handy sort whose three turf wins have all come over C&D; not firing of late, but has become dangerously well handicapped having dropped 14lb below his last winning mark.
runners.comment: All three turf wins have all come over C&D; 14lb below his last winning mark
runners.owner: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods

runners.name: Bay Breeze
runners.spotlight: Winner of eight races including one over C&D, but losing run up to 12 despite a slipping mark; not disgraced when fourth of 11 behind Great at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month, but he could really do with the ground easing.
runners.comment: Losing run up to 12 despite a slipping mark; could really do with the ground easing

runners.name: Khabib
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form, but has shown little in two starts since returning from a long absence in May; just 1-36 on turf and hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Shown little in two starts since returning from a long absence in May; just 1-36 on turf

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Tyson Fury
runners.spotlight: Four Flat wins and is rated 89 in that sphere; was never involved in the Connacht Hotel handicap here five days ago; best hurdle run when second at Killarney last time, a mistake at the last costing him; should be in the mix.
runners.comment: Poor on Flat here 5 days ago but a good Killarney hurdle run before that; be in the mix

runners.name: Columbus
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner in France and was second in a German Group 1 last year; sold for 400,000euros since; not a bad hurdling debut at Killarney but was poor back on the Flat at Royal Ascot; however, has a solid shout back hurdling and looks the stable first-string.
runners.comment: Second on hurdling debut; poor Flat run since but has a solid shout back in this sphere

runners.name: Tradonthebay
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; beaten 12l in a Roscommon handicap hurdle last time and can't be fancied here on that form.
runners.comment: Beaten 12l in a Roscommon handicap hurdle last time and can't be fancied here on that form

runners.name: Leader Allen
runners.spotlight: French bumper winner was second in a Grade 3 in that sphere when last seen in April 2025; a concern that he has been off for so long but still has to be respected from this yard even though he looks the second-string.
runners.comment: Smart bumper form in France; respected from this yard even though looks  the second-string

runners.name: Mystery Decision
runners.spotlight: Was weakening when fell two out on sole point start; tongue-tie on for rules debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Weakening when fell 2 out on sole point start; tongue-tie on for rules debut; best watched

runners.name: Tiktok Casey
runners.spotlight: Placed in a point; won a Naas bumper in testing ground before third in a Grade 2 bumper at Leopardstown; not as good in an Aintree Grade 2 since on better ground; should be capable of running well on hurdle bow.
runners.comment: Smart bumper mare; best form on soft but should be capable of running well on hurdle bow

runners.name: Young Rebel
runners.spotlight: Won a Fairyhouse bumper on debut for Mags Mullins last November, beating the smart Moonverrin into second; has since changed hands and looks to have been targetted at this meeting so has to be feared; the market can be a guide.
runners.comment: Bumper winner last winter; has to be feared and the market can be a guide

runners.name: Rene's Gold
runners.spotlight: First reserve; not much promise in two point runs so passed over on rules debut.
runners.comment: Not much promise in two point runs so passed over on rules debut; reserve

runners.name: Atlantic Gamble
runners.spotlight: Six-time Flat winner was beaten 14l off 97 in a Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last time so can't be fancied on that form.
runners.comment: Beaten 14l off 97 in a Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last time so can't be fancied on that

runners.name: Youknowthecode
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in three maiden hurdles on soft ground in the spring; however, has respected connections and is likely to do better on this sounder surface.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in three maiden hurdles on soft; respected connections so can do better

runners.name: Godsend
runners.spotlight: Five Flat wins in UK for Sir Mark Prescott up to 2m1f and rated 87; bought for 19,000gns last year; a concern that he has been off the track since but is worth a market check.
runners.comment: Five Flat wins in UK; off the track over a year but is worth a market check

runners.name: Leva Deva
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; poor in a maiden hurdle and bumper at Sligo so passed over today.
runners.comment: Poor in a maiden hurdle and bumper at Sligo so passed over today; reserve

runners.name: Digby Bridge
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; fourth foal; brother to 1m4f/13.5f winner Golden Bugle (RPR 90), half-brother to 1m winner Golden Love (59); dam 1m winner (inc Listed; 107), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand; by a fine dual-purpose sire from a quality damline; 45,000gns yearling; worth a market check.
runners.comment: By a dual-purpose sire from a quality damline; 45,000gns yearling; market check; reserve

runners.name: Eastwatch
runners.spotlight: Smart Flat sort has won twice and seems to stay 1m2f; a solid run in a Curragh Group 3 in April and now rated 101; has stamina to prove on hurdling debut but could be a player if jumping soundly.
runners.comment: Smart on Flat; stamina to prove on hurdling debut but could be a player if jumping soundly

runners.name: Golden Handshake
runners.spotlight: Two wins up to 1m4f when trained by William Haggas before being sold for 30,000gns; makes hurdling debut after an absence and could run well; the market can help.
runners.comment: Decent on Flat; makes hurdlng debut after an absence; could run well; the market can help

runners.name: Rumble Demosa
runners.spotlight: Respectable midfield finishes in both maiden hurdle runs and looks one for handicaps in time.
runners.comment: Midfield finishes in both maiden hurdle runs and looks one for handicaps in time

runners.name: Lincoln Mill
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on second point start; showed a glimpse of ability in a Tramore bumper but needs to do much better here.
runners.comment: Showed a glimpse of ability in a Tramore bumper but needs to do much better here

runners.name: Hinchinbrooke
runners.spotlight: A 1m2f AW winner for Jane Chapple Hyam last year; beaten 29l in a Cork maiden hurdle on stable debut last month; needs plenty of improvement from that; tongue-tie on.
runners.comment: Beaten 29l in a Cork maiden hurdle last month; needs plenty of improvement from that

runners.name: The Flying Rambler
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle at Bellewstown so is best watched for the time being.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle at Bellewstown so is best watched

runners.name: Everyday Life
runners.spotlight: Best point run came when second in February; well beaten in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle; lots to find; hood on.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle; lots to find; hood on

runners.name: Thedreamistilalive
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way at Kilbeggan on debut and passed over today.

runners.name: Finjimk
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in all starts in different disciplines so is one for handicaps in time.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in all starts in different disciplines so is one for handicaps in time

runners.name: Banphrionsa Alainn
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Punchestown maiden hurdle on debut for Tony Mullins; passed over today.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a Punchestown maiden hurdle on debut for Tony Mullins; passed over

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Come On The Lads
runners.spotlight: Won this last year off a 3lb lower mark; some good hurdle runs in defeat after while also won over fences; beaten 10l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time but is 7lb better off so a player.
runners.comment: Won this in 2025; beaten 10l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; 7lb better off

runners.name: Kimi De Mai
runners.spotlight: Won three bumpers in France but is yet to score over hurdles for this yard; best run in a valuable handicap at Leopardstown in February but was poor in a maiden since; a player if back to best.
runners.comment: Some good runs in defeat over hurdles but was poor in a maiden last time; needs best

runners.name: Fiveonefive
runners.spotlight: Four of his five wins came in Britain, with three at Cartmel; posted a solid run at Ballinrobe last time and should run well again off 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Posted a solid run at Ballinrobe last time and should run well again off 1lb higher

runners.name: Eye Of A Tiger
runners.spotlight: First reserve; won for the second time over hurdles when taking a Ballinrobe handicap on latest; up 4lb but can be competitive if getting a run.
runners.comment: Won a Ballinrobe h'cap last time; up 4lb but can be competitive if getting a run; reserve

runners.name: Paul's Dream
runners.spotlight: Has been in the form of her life at present, winning handicaps at Ballinrobe (2m) and Kilbeggan (2m4f); got a 10lb rise for that and back down in trip but still has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Got a 10lb rise for last time and back down in trip but still has to be on the shortlist

runners.name: Red Glory
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner won his last hurdle race over C&D last October; ran a solid race from the front to be third to Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; 3lb better off and cheekpieces added; chance.
runners.comment: Third to Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; 3lb better off and cheekpieces added

runners.name: Spy
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner won a Listowel handicap hurdle in June but was beaten 13l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; has to rebound.
runners.comment: Beaten 13l by Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last time; has to rebound

runners.name: Arcland
runners.spotlight: Dual purpose winner won for the second time over hurdles when narrowly taking a 2m4f Killarney handicap last time; needs more down in trip off 7lb higher.
runners.comment: Won a 2m4f Killarney handicap last time; needs more down in trip off 7lb higher
runners.owner: Exors of the Late E Blaney

runners.name: Matt Connor
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner was well beaten at Punchestown on his last hurdle run but ran a decent race on the Flat at Tramore since; needs to find more.
runners.comment: Ran a decent race on the Flat last time; needs to find more back over hurdles

runners.name: Berto Ramirez
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on the Flat but took a Down Royal maiden hurdle in May; might have been unsuited by soft ground when poor in a Roscommon novice last time; solid fourth on the Flat here on Thursday.
runners.comment: Might have been unsuited by soft ground when poor in a Roscommon novice last time
runners.owner: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler

runners.name: Serienmond
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner was below form over hurdles on his last two starts for Gavin Cromwell last winter; however, would have a chance off this mark if restored to his best.
runners.comment: Below form when last seen but would have a chance off this mark if restored to his best

runners.name: Minella Post
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres but was running a big race in a Cork maiden hurdle before falling last time; cheekpieces are added and capable of a decent showing.
runners.comment: Running well before falling last time; cheekpieces are added; capable of a decent showing

runners.name: Metamorpheus
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; is 1-19 over hurdles but some decent efforts in defeat lately including on the Flat; 1lb out of the handicap; needs more.
runners.comment: Decent runs in defeat lately including on the Flat; 1lb out of h'cap; needs more; reserve

runners.name: Wholelotofbusiness
runners.spotlight: Killarney novice hurdle winner last October has run well at times in defeat since, notably back at that track in May; poor behind Spy at Listowel since so questions.
runners.comment: Good run at Killarney in May but poor behind Spy at Listowel since so questions

runners.name: Avalo
runners.spotlight: Won for the second time over hurdles when scoring at Punchestown in May (form franked) over this trip; raised 7lb for that and is up in grade but goes well fresh so has to be respected.
runners.comment: Raised 7lb for last win and is up in grade but goes well fresh so has to be respected
runners.owner: Seamus Perry & Brian P Larkin & Ms Bernadette Leigh

runners.name: Lips Freedom
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat sort on the continent has got his act together over hurdles, winning at Downpatrick and Killarney 109 days apart; seems best fresh but if he can back that up off 9lb higher then he is a player.
runners.comment: Has won last two; seems best fresh but if he can back up off 9lb higher then is a player

runners.name: Jetoile
runners.spotlight: Better known as a chaser and won a Ballinrobe handicap in that discipline in May; ran well on the first of two Flat starts since; hasn't run over hurdles since 2022 but could go well.
runners.comment: Won over fences in May; hasn't run over hurdles since 2022 but could go well

runners.name: Path d'Oroux
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner and was third in this race in 2023 off 6lb higher; regressive over fences last season but a decent Flat run at Killarney last time; could run well.
runners.comment: Third in this race in 2023 off 6lb higher; decent Flat run last time; could run well

runners.name: No Looking Back
runners.spotlight: Won a Limerick 4yo Grade 2 in 2022 but no win since; some decent efforts in defeat earlier this year but was well beaten in a 2m4f Punchestown handicap last time; the drop in trip may help.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a 2m4f Punchestown handicap last time; the drop in trip may help

runners.name: Slurricane
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner is at his best on testing ground; last win came on the Flat here in October 2025; well beaten on the level here three days ago.
runners.comment: At his best on testing ground; well beaten on the level here three days ago

runners.name: Dani Donadoni
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner looked set to score over 3m at Wexford before being run down by Kiltealy Park; similar effort in a Roscommon novice down to 2m since; needs more back in a handicap but considered.
runners.comment: Decent runs in defeat in conditions hurdles last twice; needs more back in a h'cap

runners.name: Dream On Baby
runners.spotlight: Last win came in a Listed hurdle in November at Kempton over 2m5f; some good runs after but was below form at Cheltenham; a decent Flat run last time at Tramore; considered.
runners.comment: Last win came in a Listed hurdle in November; decent Flat run last time; considered

runners.name: Stede Bonnet
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner is 2-8 over hurdles, both wins coming over about 2m; solid runs in defeat in 2m4f handicaps the last twice and should be competitive off same mark.
runners.comment: Solid runs in defeat in handicaps the last twice and should be competitive off same mark

runners.name: Ad Caelum
runners.spotlight: Won at Kilbeggan in June, his fifth hurdle win, but was beaten a long way there since so has to bounce back in a competitive race.
runners.comment: Won at Kilbeggan in June but beaten a long way there since so has to bounce back

runners.name: Minella Diamond
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in 2023 built on his Clonmel maiden win when scoring at Limerick on handicap debut, both over approx' 2m4f; up 10lb but is an improving sort and should stay this trip.
runners.comment: Built on Clonmel maiden win when scoring at Limerick; up 10lb but is an improving sort

runners.name: Burning Ability
runners.spotlight: Some decent runs in dxefeat in bumpers; won a Listowel maiden over 2m4f and was just denied in a Bellewstown handicap over 3m since; up 3lb but improving sort can be competitive.
runners.comment: Listowel maiden winner was just denied in a Bellewstown h'cap; can be competitive

runners.name: Mousey Brown
runners.spotlight: Five wins between hurdles and fences up to 3m; decent runs in defeat over hurdles and fences last twice so one to consider.
runners.comment: Decent runs in defeat over hurdles and fences last twice so one to consider

runners.name: Sir Galahad
runners.spotlight: Second runner for UK yard; won for the fifth time over hurdles at Uttoxeter last time, scoring by 11l over 2m4f; has to be respected even up 10lb and looks likely to stay too.
runners.comment: Won for the fifth time over hurdles at Uttoxeter last time; has to be respected up 10lb

runners.name: Grann's Boy
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has been soundly beaten on his last three hurdle runs and needs a return to his best.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on last three hurdle runs and needs a return to his best

runners.name: Elusive Ogie
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden hurdle winner last year has posted some decent runs in defeat since including at Killarney last time; however, needs more in a tougher race.
runners.comment: A decent run at Killarney last time but needs more in a tougher race; reserve

runners.name: Ifiwerearichman
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable 2m handicap here in 2023 and won over fences after; solid runs at Wexford and Bellewstown lately, with the latter run looking better after the win of Putapoundinthejar in the Galway Hurdle; can run a sound race if staying.
runners.comment: Solid runs at Wexford and Bellewstown lately and likely to run a sound race if staying

runners.name: American Mike
runners.spotlight: Formerly smart chaser when trained by Gordon Elliott, winning in Grade 2 company and placed in Grade 1 bumpers; not a bad hurdle run last time at Worcester but this is much more competitive.
runners.comment: Formerly smart chaser when trained by Gordon Elliott; not a bad hurdle run last time

runners.name: Pinot Gris
runners.spotlight: Won over fences last time at Wexford (2m3f); dual hurdle winner and has posted some smart form in this sphere over shorter; has a chance if getting back to best hurdle form and staying this trip.
runners.comment: Won over fences last time; has a chance if getting back to best hurdle form

runners.name: Bunting
runners.spotlight: Is 1-12 over hurdles; well beaten back on the Flat at Royal Ascot last time; needs a return to best hurdle form but can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Is 1-12 over hurdles; well beaten at Royal Ascot last time; needs a return to best

runners.name: Kiltealy Park
runners.spotlight: Has posted five wins between hurdles and fences; beat Dani Donadoni in a conditions race over 3m at Wexford last time; a 6lb rise makes this a tougher task but promising 5lb claimer helps.
runners.comment: Beat Dani Donadoni over 3m at Wexford last time; 6lb rise makes this a tougher task

runners.name: Koori Star
runners.spotlight: Point and hurdle winner has been soundly beaten over fences lately but would have a shout on his best hurdles form of last year.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten over fences lately but would have a shout on his best hurdles form

runners.name: Sequoiaspirit
runners.spotlight: Doubled his score over hurdles when winning well at Roscommon last time, beating Stede Bonnet; however, his record is still only 2-29 and a 7lb rise makes this a tougher task up in grade.
runners.comment: Won well at Roscommon last time but a 7lb rise makes this a tougher task up in grade

runners.name: Comfort Zone
runners.spotlight: Came back to form in terrific style when winning the Connacht Hotel Flat Handicap over 2m on Monday here; hasn't run over hurdles since May 2025 but can be a big player with his confidence boosted.
runners.comment: Won the Connacht Hotel Flat H'cap on Monday and is a big player back hurdling

runners.name: Gin Tonic
runners.spotlight: Promising sort last autumn, winning a maiden and second in a novice hurdle; however, he has to rebound in a major way from two pulled-up runs.
runners.comment: Promising sort last autumn but has to rebound from two pulled-up runs

runners.name: From The Ashes
runners.spotlight: First reserve; chase winner got off the mark over hurdles at Fairyhouse in January over 3m; raised 7lb and this is a big ask off a lay-off.
runners.comment: Off the mark over hurdles at Fairyhouse in January; this a big ask off a lay-off; reserve

runners.name: Double Powerful
runners.spotlight: Six hurdle wins in Britain; some solid runs in defeat in quality handicaps since his last win including at Plumpton last time; needs more but shouldn't be far away either.
runners.comment: Six hurdle wins in UK; a solid run last time but needs more in a race of this nature

runners.name: Ambitious Fellow
runners.spotlight: The last of his four hurdle wins came in this race in 2023 off 4lb higher; mostly chasing since and blinkers added; others more likely here.
runners.comment: Last win came in this race in 2023; mostly chasing lately; others more likely

races.race_name: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares INH Flat Race

runners.name: Tamara Jane
runners.spotlight: Wide margin point-to-point winner on soft in April at Tullaherin; promising start under Rules when a 2.75l third of 14 at Wexford in May and the second from that race has won a bumper easily since; big player on that form.
runners.comment: Point winner, form of Wexford third boosted by runner up, big player on that effort
runners.owner: Whose Round Is It Now Syndicate

runners.name: Madame Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Belied odds of 66-1 to run a huge race on debut at Roscommon when she had a few of these behind; enters calculations now with improvement likely to be forthcoming.
runners.comment: Outran odds of 66-1 at Roscommon, had a few of these behind, enters calculations

runners.name: Whizz Bizz
runners.spotlight: Promise in all three starts; beaten similar distances when fifth on debut at Cork and again on second start at Wexford; didn't get a clear run when beaten 3.5l into fourth at Sligo on latest; can give another good account.
runners.comment: Promise all three starts, beaten 3.5l when fourth at Sligo latest, should go well again

runners.name: Aodha's Arrow
runners.spotlight: Has run to a similar level in all three starts; beaten 8.5l when seventh of 16 at Roscommon latest (2m, good); should be sharper for that but needs more to get her head in front.
runners.comment: Similar level of form in all three starts, beaten 8.5l on latest, needs more

runners.name: Shadonagh
runners.spotlight: Modest enough efforts in bumpers at Leopardstown when beaten 16l into fourth and at Limerick when beaten 32l into fifth; new cheekpieces need to eke out more.
runners.comment: Modest efforts in bumpers at Leopardstown and Limerick, cheekpieces tried now

runners.name: Bayswater Bloom
runners.spotlight: Best effort yet when finishing ahead of Aodha's Arrow and Back In Favour at Roscommon on latest; should strip fitter for that run and holds an each way chance.
runners.comment: Had two of these behind at Roscommon latest, strip fitter, each way chance

runners.name: Glens Sonata
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word mare; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, sister to smart bumper and 2m2f-2m6f hurdle winner Glens Melody, closely related to useful 2m-3m hurdle winner Lean Araig, out of 2m Flat, bumper and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner; lots of appeal on paper and top yard has won five of last six renewals.
runners.comment: Poet's Word mare, dam bumper winner, top yard has won five of last six renewals

runners.name: Fortunate Miss
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in point-to-points at Loughrea in May; bought for E35,000 at Tattersalls later that month; probably best watched on Rules' debut; tongue tied.
runners.comment: Bought for E35,000 after Loughrea point win, probably best watched on Rules' debut

runners.name: Sarahs Lawn
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the second attempt in point-to-points at Lisronagh for Benny Walsh in April; has joined a shrewd yard that has already had a winner here this week and this daughter of Yeats needs checking in the market on Rules' debut; tongue tied.
runners.comment: Point winner, has joined shrewd yard, needs checking in the market, tongue tied
runners.owner: For The Love Of It Syndicate

runners.name: Fleur Dino
runners.spotlight: One of two for top yard that has won five of last six renewals; Doctor Dino filly; half-sister to winners Fleur In The Park (smart bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase), Zurekin (useful 2m1f/2m2f hurdle), Hunting Brook (2m5f/3m hurdle) and Marie Philippe (bumper); dam useful 2m1f-2m5f chase winner; preferred by Patrick Mullins.
runners.comment: Doctor Dino filly, half-sister to two bumper winners, preferred by Patrick Mullins

runners.name: No Pass Port
runners.spotlight: Harzand filly; half-sister to winners Phantom Gold (bumper/2m4f hurdle) and Parisian Fashion (2m4f hurdle); dam useful bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner; makes some appeal on paper and worth checking in the market; tongue tied.
runners.comment: Harzand filly, dam useful bumper winner, makes some appeal on paper; tongue tied

runners.name: She Was The One
runners.spotlight: Placed in one of two starts in point-to-points; bought for E25,000 after finishing second of four finishers at Oldcastle; percentage call is to watch on Rules' bow.
runners.comment: Bought for E25,000 after Oldcastle second, likely best watched on Rules' bow

runners.name: Techno Dj
runners.spotlight: Was bang there when falling at the last in sole point-to-point start at Lisronagh in April; bumper winners in pedigree and yard had a bumper winner at Ballinrobe last month; market can guide on Rules' debut.
runners.comment: In contention when falling at the last in sole point, market can guide on Rules' debut
runners.owner: Going For The One Syndicate/Michael McEvoy/Jimmy Whittle

runners.name: Theboss'sdaughter
runners.spotlight: Old Persian filly; half-sister to winners Miami Present (useful 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase) and Florida Calling (point); dam German 7f/7.5f winner, half-sister to 1m Listed Flat and useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Moon Over Miami; market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: Old Persian filly, dam German 7f/7.5f winner, market best guide on debut

runners.name: Tanga Mugi
runners.spotlight: First reserve; every chance when falling two out in same Lisronagh point as Techno DJ; made amends when bolting up at Necarne; subsequently bought for 32,000GBP and worth monitoring in the market if getting a run.
runners.comment: Bought for 32,000GBP after Necarne win, check market if gets a run; reserve

runners.name: Eleen Alana
runners.spotlight: 40-1 but creditable effort on debut at Killarney last month, showing up well before fading in the final furlong into a 6.5l third of 15; likely to improve for that run and outside place claims.
runners.comment: 40-1 but creditable run on debut at Killarney, open to improvement, minor place shout

runners.name: Withmylittleeye
runners.spotlight: Displayed potential on debut at Limerick (2m, soft) two months ago, outpaced but keeping on for a 9.75l third of 9; should come on for that and now sports a tongue tie; not discounted for place purposes.
runners.comment: Decent debut third at Limerick, should improve, tongue tie on, place chance

runners.name: Back In Favour
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner finished 2.75l behind Aodha's Arrow on Rules' debut in a Roscommon bumper when 11-1; major improvement required.
runners.comment: Point winner, 2.75l behind Aodha's Arrow at Roscommon latest, must improve

runners.name: Bluebell Breeze
runners.spotlight: Okay effort when fourth at Tramore on debut; didn't build on that when tailed off at Cork latest; others preferred.
runners.comment: Okay effort at Tramore on debut, tailed off on latest at Cork, others preferred

runners.name: Nancy Wheeler
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats at big odds in bumpers at Roscommon and Wexford; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats at big odds in both starts, seems safe to rule out

runners.name: Gunner Girl
runners.spotlight: 25-1 and beaten 25l on debut at Tramore in May; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 25-1 and beaten 25l on debut at Tramore in May, others make more appeal

runners.name: Zarak Pasha
runners.spotlight: A 75,000gns breeze-up purchase in April and from a middle-distance family; recovered from a slow start to run well on debut at Killarney over this trip; can be more competitive with that experience behind him.
runners.comment: Recovered from a slow start to run well on debut at Killarney; can be more competitive

runners.name: Roy Bean
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to winners Pinot Gris (10.3f/1m5f Flat, RPR 87; useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and Postdamerstrasse (Italian 7.5f); dam 1m4f/12.5f winner (85); E18,000 foal made E40,000 as a yearling; by a promising first-crop sire and related to winners so could run respectably.
runners.comment: By a promising first-crop sire and related to winners so could run respectably

runners.name: Thomas Chippendale
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Alluringly (9.4f Listed) and Toogood Tobetrue (useful 6f 2yo), from the family of Derby winners and oustanding sires Galileo and Sea The Stars; E300,000 yearling is the stable second-string on debut but is still respected.
runners.comment: Well-bred sort; is the stable second-string on debut but is still respected

runners.name: Victory Speech
runners.spotlight: Brother to 6f Group 2 2yo winner Beautify; was the stable second-string on debut when runner-up in what is traditionally a strong Curragh maiden; that was 7f but looked as if he would stay this trip; looks the one to beat on that run.
runners.comment: Runner-up in what is traditionally a strong Curragh maiden; the one to beat on that run
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Bang Bang
runners.spotlight: Rated 74; promise in maidens last year (including here over 7f on soft) and in first two runs this term at Leopardstown; no impact behind Gliondar in 1m Curragh maiden on good latest; could do better back on softer ground in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Rated 74, disappointed on good ground latest, may rebound back on softer ground; blinkers

runners.name: Saliba
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye when a 6.25l third of 16 on debut at Gowran; had excuses when sixth on latest at Naas (scoped dirty); tricky draw here and Foley prefers Royal Bones.
runners.comment: Promising debut, scoped dirty after latest, tricky draw here, Foley prefers Royal Bones

runners.name: Storzando
runners.spotlight: Minor promise over 7f at Fairyhouse on debut and built on that when a 1l third of 7 upped to 10.5f (good) at Down Royal at 80-1; place claims dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: Minor promise on debut, fine third at Down Royal latest, place chance back in trip

runners.name: Suir Monad
runners.spotlight: Has displayed winning potential when fourth in maidens at Dundalk in December (7f) and at Gowran (1m, soft) in April; off 114 days but clearly has ability, is well drawn and market can guide.
runners.comment: Potential in both maidens, off 114 days but has ability, well drawn, market best guide

runners.name: Royal Bones
runners.spotlight: Betrayed inexperience when a 3.25l sixth of 15 in a Curragh maiden on debut in May (1m2f, good); should improve plenty for that run and the choice of Foley but whether this drop back in trip will suit is debateable and drawn wide.
runners.comment: Betrayed inexperience on Curragh debut, can improve but drop in trip not sure to suit

runners.name: Desert Swing
runners.spotlight: Make Believe gelding; brother to 1m AW winner Suspicion (RPR 85); dam unraced half-sister to winners Ninjago (6f Listed) and Florestans Match (6f), out of French 7.5f Listed winner; likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Make Believe gelding, brother to 1m AW winner, likely best watched on debut
runners.owner: Sheikh Khalid Bin Ali Al Khalifa

runners.name: Aghadrum Boy
runners.spotlight: Modest effort on debut at Limerick last month when 22-1; may need more time and experience.
runners.comment: Modest effort on debut at Limerick, may need more time and experience

runners.name: Rest Your Mind
runners.spotlight: Glimmers of ability in three runs last season for John Kiely; caught the eye of the stewards when a never nearer sixth on final start for that stable here over 7f in October (heavy); worth a market check on first run for new yard.
runners.comment: Glimmers of ability last season inc' here, worth market check on debut for new stable

runners.name: Chloe's Boy
runners.spotlight: Huge odds for all three starts and slowly away in two of them; hard to make a case for on form.
runners.comment: Huge odds and no impact in all three starts, can be slowly away, hard to fancy

runners.name: Lamar Valley
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and beaten 20l on debut in fillies' maiden at Gowran; may need more time.
runners.comment: 33-1 and no impact on debut at Gowran, may need more time

runners.name: Kingcharles
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in barrier trial; modest efforts in maidens at Navan and Gowran; will get a handicap mark after this.
runners.comment: Modest efforts in maidens at Navan and Gowran; will get handicap mark after this

runners.name: Quinchy Lady
runners.spotlight: 80-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Gowran; hard to fancy
runners.comment: 80-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Gowran, hard to fancy

runners.name: Romantic War
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden rated just 30; impossible to fancy in a race of this nature.
runners.comment: Modest maiden rated just 30, impossible to fancy in a race of this nature

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: First reserve; went close in Down Royal handicap in May (7f, soft) off 2lb lower; in excellent form in claimers, winning at Bellewstown and Killarney then second at Ballinrobe; poorly drawn but can't discount in current form.
runners.comment: In fine form in claimers, poorly drawn here but can't discount in current form; reserve

runners.name: Gloriously Glam
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner claimed out of Ado McGuinness' yard for E10,000 after finishing a 0.5l second behind in form Minaun View in Bellewstown claimer; 8lb below last handicap win but difficult draw on first start for new stable.
runners.comment: Runner up in claimer latest, 8lb below last h'cap win, poorly drawn for stable debut

runners.name: Spent All Me Money
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year and is now 2lb below his last success but heavy defeats both starts this term; blinkers go back on but they didn't do much for him when he wore them before.
runners.comment: Two wins last year, 2lb below last success but heavy defeats both starts this term

runners.name: Mickey The Steel
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; generally reliable sort knows how to win and has been in decent form this term, placing in five of his seven starts; more than capable off this mark but may need softer ground to get his head back in front.
runners.comment: Placed in five of seven runs this term, capable off this mark, rain would help; reserve

runners.name: The Sweet Escape
runners.spotlight: British raider seeking a hat-trick after back to back fast ground wins over 7.5f at Beverley; has gone up 8lb for those two victories; clearly in fine fettle and nicely drawn but may need quicker ground.
runners.comment: British raider, up 8lb for successive wins at Beverley, well-drawn, may need faster ground

runners.name: Storm Averted
runners.spotlight: Won this race last year off 4lb lower for Mick Mulvany; has run well on all three previous visits to this venue and should be sharper for her seasonal reappearance and stable debut at Ballinrobe 40 days ago; visor added to tongue tie; could go well.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 4lb higher, strip fitter for latest, visor added, could go well

runners.name: Marta's Prince
runners.spotlight: Two wins when trained in France over 6f and 1m1f; no impact in first two runs for this stable; mark sliding but drawn wide and others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Two wins in France, no show in two runs for this yard, mark sliding but drawn wide

runners.name: Faoladh
runners.spotlight: Gained second career win off just 1lb higher at Down Royal in May (7f, good); lost form since and was soundly beaten behind a couple of these rivals over 8.5f here on Tuesday; would prefer a sounder surface.
runners.comment: Won off 1lb higher at Down Royal in May, well beaten here on Tuesday, best on good ground

runners.name: La La Lucrative
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; in excellent form this season, winning two of his three starts; ran on well to score off 8lb lower at Roscommon latest (7.5f, good); this is a tougher race and he'll need a career best to follow up.
runners.comment: Won 2-3 this year, up 8lb for latest win, this harder, career best needed; reserve

runners.name: Lough Leane
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for this yard at Ballinrobe in May (9.5f, gd-yld) off 6lb lower; has struggled twice since and may be on a tough mark for now.
runners.comment: Struggled twice off revised rating since Ballinrobe win, may be on tough mark for now

runners.name: Buttermere Ridge
runners.spotlight: Has failed to add to his Gowran maiden win in April 2024 (7f, good); not a bad effort when a close fourth behind Minaun View in a Bellewstown claimer latest (Gloriously Glam second); handicap form unconvincing; new headgear combination tried.
runners.comment: No joy since maiden win in 2024, decent effort in claimer latest, h'cap form unconvincing

runners.name: San Aer
runners.spotlight: Goes well at this venue and was only reeled in close to home over 8.5f here on Tuesday; runs off the same mark now and nicely drawn so can't discount dropped back in trip; obvious chance.
runners.comment: Reeled in close to home over 8.5f here on Tuesday, same mark here, drops in trip, chance

runners.name: Bay Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Won at Bellewstown on penultimate; raised 8lb but ran a very respectable race over 8.5f here on Tuesday when not far behind San Aer; this trip may be on the sharp side, however; cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Fine run over 8.5f here on Tuesday, this trip may be on the sharp side; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Apache Outlaw
runners.spotlight: Had been running well before a below par effort at the Curragh last time over an inadequate 5f; runner up over C&D last year off 8lb higher; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Poor over 5f latest, runner up over C&D last year off 8lb higher, could bounce back

runners.name: Navagio
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner but no joy since July 2023; mark sliding but hasn't looked like taking advantage in recent starts; beaten 10.5l when down the field at the Curragh on latest.
runners.comment: No win since 2023, mark sliding but recent efforts poor, beaten 10.5l on latest

runners.name: Rhythm King
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner on heavy ground; back from 274 days off with okay run over 8.5f here on Tuesday when behind San Aer and Bay Of Dreams; however, beat just one rival home over 1m4f here on Thursday; this trip more suitable but needs to rebound.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner on heavy, okay 8.5f run here on Tuesday, well beaten over 1m4f on Thurs'

runners.name: Ivatt
runners.spotlight: Maiden showed more than enough for Charlie Fellowes last season to suggest he could win races; below best when last seen at Newmarket in October; worth a market check on debut for Gordon Elliott.
runners.comment: Maiden, showed winning potential in Britain, check market on seasonal/stable debut

runners.name: Fratas
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a purple patch in 2023, winning five times on the Flat (and once over hurdles) for Mick Mulvany; solid run over hurdles here on Wednesday; won over 8.5f at this meeting in 2023, this trip is within her range and she's 4lb below her last success; player.
runners.comment: Course winner, decent run over hurdles here on Wed', 4lb below last Flat win, player

runners.name: Thatwilldoso
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner landed this race last season off 72; was running off that mark when winning at Roscommon on latest (10.5f, good); 6lb rise makes things tougher but she's got a nice low draw, ground is fine and should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 6lb lower, narrow win at Roscommon latest, well drawn, in the mix

runners.name: Sir Jeremy
runners.spotlight: Gained second turf win at Roscommon in May (10.5f, yielding) off 4lb lower; has come up short twice since off revised mark but ran well off 1lb higher at this meeting last year over 8.5f so not dismissed stepped up in trip in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Won off 4lb lower at Roscommon in May, poor since but ran well here last year, blinkers on

runners.name: Unterberg
runners.spotlight: Best on AW (6-12) but just 1-20 on turf; scored at Dundalk in March but soundly beaten back on turf the last twice (7l behind Thatwilldoso on penultimate); drawn wide; others more convincing.
runners.comment: Prolific on AW but 1-20 on turf, soundly beaten last twice, drawn wide, others preferred

runners.name: Daonethatgotaway
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins came over 1m but proved stamina for 1m4f when scoring at Dundalk in February; nice prep run for this at Navan over 1m2f and the step back up to this trip is a plus but he's got a tricky draw to overcome.
runners.comment: Both turf wins at 1m, won over 1m4f on AW in Feb', nice prep for this latest, tricky draw

runners.name: Tribal Moon
runners.spotlight: Two-time 1m AW winner for former yard; went close on debut for this stable on last Flat start at Dundalk (10.5f); no impact over hurdles last thrice and 0-7 record on turf on the Flat doesn't inspire confidence; drawn wide.
runners.comment: Two-time AW winner, 0-7 on turf on the Flat, poor over hurdles recently, drawn wide

runners.name: Steps In The Sand
runners.spotlight: First reserve; dual-purpose mare is 3-25 on turf on the Flat; last won over 1m6f (yielding) at this meeting last year; remains 7lb above that last success and this season's form has been modest; due to run here 8.10 on Friday.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose, won over 1m6f here last year, this year's form modest; reserve

runners.name: Thyer
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m winner in Britain, both on good ground; no show last year for this stable but both runs this year encouraging, only beaten 2.25l when fifth at Ayr latest (1m2f, good); not well drawn here, however, and may need quicker ground; visored.
runners.comment: Dual good ground winner in Britain, better runs last twice but poorly drawn here; visor

runners.name: Royal Saxo
runners.spotlight: Ex-French performer 4-12 on the AW but just 1-11 on turf for former yard; yet to show much since joining this stable but drops in grade and shrewd yard won nice pot here earlier this week; check the market.
runners.comment: Ex-French performer, yet to show much for this yard but drops in grade, check the market

runners.name: Deralo Ir
runners.spotlight: French recruit; placed twice for former yard in 2025; 50-1 and never figured on return from 407 days off on stable debut at Ballinrobe 12 days ago; drawn wide and probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Placed a couple of times in France, no impression on stable bow latest, drawn wide

runners.name: Superficial
runners.spotlight: Up 6lb for breakthrough Flat win at Roscommon in May (1m4f, yielding), beating subsequent winner Obscenity by 2.75l; soundly beaten in Punchestown maiden hurdle latest but has to be considered back on the level from low draw.
runners.comment: Up 6lb for Roscommon win, beaten over hurdles latest, considered back on the Flat

runners.name: Granville Street
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won on the Flat since scoring over C&D at this meeting in 2023; went close at Navan in April (1m5f, gd-yld) off 2lb lower; hasn't backed that up since but did run a nice race over hurdles here on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Last won over C&D in 2023, second at Navan in April, decent run over timber here on Wed'

runners.name: Arch Enemy
runners.spotlight: Seven-time turf winner on a hat-trick after back to back wins at Navan (1m2f, good) and Killarney (11.5f, good); has gone up 11lb for those wins but she has won off higher marks in the past; however, was unplaced in the 5.40 here on Thursday.
runners.comment: Gone up 11lb for back-to-back wins at Navan & Killarney, has won off higher mark before

runners.name: Ephesus
runners.spotlight: Both Flat wins at this trip, a Curragh maiden on good in July 2024 and a Roscommon handicap (soft) off 6lb lower last October; has failed to fire on previous runs at this venue, including when beaten 19l over 16.5f here on Wednesday.
runners.comment: 6lb above last win, course form poor, beaten 19l over 16.5f here on Wednesday

runners.name: Brosna Town
runners.spotlight: British raider; won twice on the Flat when trained by Dermot Weld (1-9 on turf); ran well in a Market Rasen maiden hurdle on penultimate; out of depth in Listed hurdle here earlier this week; this more realistic but difficult draw.
runners.comment: Out of depth in Listed hurdle here on Tuesday, this more realistic, drawn wide

runners.name: Cala Bonita
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; dual AW winner at 10.5f is 1-11 on turf; that win came over 1m (good) at Gowran in May 2025 off 9lb lower; not a bad run over 8.5f here on Tuesday then won nicely over the same trip on Thursday; could go well stepped up in trip; 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Kept on well over 8.5f here on Tuesday, won nicely at that trip on Thursday; reserve

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; off the mark in 9.5f (good) handicap at Gowran on latest; hit hard for that with a 10lb rise and this is a deeper race; needs to improve further for this step up in trip.
runners.comment: Up 10lb for first win at Gowran latest, this is harder, more needed up in trip; reserve

runners.name: Pillar Of Hope
runners.spotlight: 5-26 on turf; just 2lb higher than when winning at Leopardstown in October (1m2f, heavy); beaten 3.75l into fifth in this race last season off this mark but hard to fancy on this season's efforts and others look better treated.
runners.comment: 5-26 on turf, fifth in this last year, out of sorts this term, others better treated

races.race_name: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Stoneacre Joe
runners.spotlight: Boasts the best form in this line-up, having twice finished second (once over C&D) on fast ground in the spring, but seems to have lost his way since; beaten over 18l when last of four at Ripon (6f, good) a fortnight ago and arrives here with questions to answer.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in the spring but has lost his way since and has questions to answer

runners.name: Brash
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when dropped to 5f for latest run and remains unproven on ground quicker than good, but was placed twice over 6f beforehand (maiden/handicap) and can play a major role if aided by first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Not at best over 5f last time but placed twice over 6f beforehand; major player

runners.name: Kohana Nation
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when second at Newcastle (7f, AW) in December, despite racing too freely; makes turf debut after 225-day break but the drop in trip could be a good move; big player if fully tuned up.
runners.comment: Absent since 7f AW second in December but a big player if fully tuned up

runners.name: Sakura Impact
runners.spotlight: Out of a Japanese 6f/7f dirt winner; soundly beaten when last of three on recent debut at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm); now tries sprinting.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten when last of three on recent debut at Yarmouth (1m); now tries sprinting

runners.name: Spruces Due
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both outings, the latest here (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in June; drops back to 6f with hood added today.
runners.comment: Well beaten on both outings (6f/7f); now hooded

runners.name: Triple P
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 7l when fourth of six in run-of-the-mill Redcar maiden (7f, good to firm) on debut a fortnight ago; needs improvement here but is entitled to have learnt from that outing.
runners.comment: Beaten about 7l when fourth of six in run-of-the-mill 7f Redcar maiden last month

races.race_name: Bapp Group Of Companies Bapp Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Eighth Immortal
runners.spotlight: Favourite both starts, when unable to hold off a strong finisher at Leicester (7f, good) and unable to threaten at Chester (6f, good; third at 11-10); the winner on first occasion took the Group 2 Vintage at Goodwood this week for his second win since, and the third also won next time; moving back up to 7f should help this one on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Debut 2nd has been boosted no end, but not by him when 3rd at Chester; 7f should help

runners.name: Lincoln Warrior
runners.spotlight: Second at Wolverhampton (6f, AW; 66-1) in June, always front rank, was much better than his runs on good ground either side; just behind Eighth Immortal at Chester (6f) latest, with that rival going past him; late foal who's bred to stay 1m+.
runners.comment: AW second in June was much better than his runs on good ground either side; up from 6f
runners.owner: Spg Property, Alfa Site & Graeme Curnow

runners.name: Encounter
runners.spotlight: All three races were over 7f on good ground, best on second occasion when third of seven at Sandown despite having traffic issues and stumbling; raced up with pace, but faded, when favourite there last time; goes handicapping and his earlier promise can't be forgotten.
runners.comment: Faded when favourite last time; promise of his previous start can't be forgotten, though

runners.name: Weleyff
runners.spotlight: Third at Beverley (7.4f, good) and justified favouritism in a five-runner novice at Ayr (7f, good to firm) four weeks later, outpaced over 2f out but rallying strongly; the fourth from that Ayr race is the only one to have run since and he won; while 1m might have made more appeal, this one clearly looks capable of better.
runners.comment: Won five-runner Ayr novice (7f, good to firm), outpaced over 2f out but rallying strongly

runners.name: Prince Kameo
runners.spotlight: Modest form on first two starts (6f, AW/good) and stiff task when well beaten on soft ground for latest; gelded since; bred to stay 1m/1m2f in time and needs a market check on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Up from 6f; bred to stay 1m/1m2f in time and needs a market check on this handicap debut

races.race_name: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Band D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tiora Time
runners.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling and half-sister to a 6f winner; 18-1 at Epsom (7f, good to firm) but beaten only 2l after starting slowly; should be wiser this time and have every chance.
runners.comment: 18-1 at Epsom (7f, good to firm) but beaten only 2l after starting slowly

runners.name: Cheeky Chesca
runners.spotlight: The form of her second places give her a chance but now 0-7 and very disappointing in her last two races, latterly tried in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Now 0-7 and very disappointing in her last two races, latterly tried in cheekpieces

runners.name: Forest Berry
runners.spotlight: Beaten 2l and less in her last three starts, all over 6f; narrowly denied last time at Chepstow (good to firm) and shouldn't be far away, unless there's a useful newcomer lurking.
runners.comment: Beaten 2l and less in her last three starts, all over 6f; narrowly denied last time

runners.name: Dawn's Gift
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; 13th foal; half-sister to five winners including Staxton (6f; RPR 106), Lazarus Bell (7f 2yo; 89), Classic Pursuit (prolific 5f/6f; 89) and Satin Snake (7f; 81); dam 1m4f winner (80); rare 2yo runner for the yard.
runners.comment: 5,000gns yearling; 13th foal; half-sister to five winners; rare 2yo runner for yard

runners.name: Tiggywinkle
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f winner Eye Of Dubai (RPR 97); dam French 7.5f-1m2f winner, half-sister to German 1m3f winner Sokol; makes sense to check the betting.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 6f/7f winner Eye Of Dubai (RPR 97); dam French 7.5f-1m2f winner

runners.name: Theft
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros 2yo; second foal; dam 1m-1m4f winner (RPR 87), closely related to winners Green Storm (Group-placed 1m1f 2yo) and Bulldog Spirit (1m-1m6f); trainer has sent out ten 2yo winners on turf this season.
runners.comment: 10,000euros 2yo; second foal; dam 1m-1m4f winner (RPR 87)

runners.name: Bearing In Time
runners.spotlight: 8,000gns yearling; half-sister to 5f winner Beerwah (RPR 70); dam placed 5f-1m (102), sister to 7f winner Jalaad; stable's newcomers are usually best watched.
runners.comment: 8,000gns yearling; half-sister to 5f winner Beerwah (RPR 70); dam placed 5f-1m

runners.name: Eagle Storm
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns foal; seventh foal; half-sister to 7f winner One Night Thunder (RPR 93); dam 6f AW winner (91), out of 1m4f/2m winning sister to Group 2 winners Nearly Caught (1m7f) and Pale Mimosa (2m); the market should be informative.
runners.comment: 5,000gns foal; seventh foal; half-sister to 7f winner One Night Thunder (RPR 93)

runners.name: Pon Pon Dalia
runners.spotlight: 13,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Ziggy's Triton (multiple 5f; RPR 96), Soller Bay (6f-1m1f; 68) and Mullazem (7f/1m); dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Furas; stable had a newcomer win on debut earlier this week.
runners.comment: 13,000gns yearling; stable had a newcomer win on debut earlier this week

runners.name: Romotoso
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to winners Militia (5f/6f; RPR 93), Faster Bee (7f; 76) and Shamadram (6f-1m); dam placed 1m AW 2yo (71), half-sister to winners Tactician (1m6f Listed) and Promotion (Listed-placed 1m2f); trainer having a good season with his 2yos.
runners.comment: Newcomer for a yard that's having a good season with 2yos

runners.name: Autumn Jewel
runners.spotlight: Low-level form thus far (over 5f) and likely to fare better when handicapping.
runners.comment: Low-level form thus far (over 5f) and likely to fare better when handicapping

runners.name: Arenite
runners.spotlight: No match for a subsequent winner at Redcar in May (6f, good) but that was a promising start; pressed the leader and kept on; can improve.
runners.comment: No match for a subsequent winner at Redcar in May (6f, good) but that a promising start
runners.owner: G H Thompson And Michael Dods

runners.name: Mariner
runners.spotlight: Some return to form in his last two races and wasn't far away over 1m here last time when a stronger pace would have helped; interesting returned to further, having won over this far.
runners.comment: Positive last run and interesting returned to further, having won over this far

runners.name: Magic Runner
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 9.4f on the AW during the winter; probably okay on turf (0-4) but last two runs were heavy defeats and she's been off since March.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner; last two runs were heavy defeats and she's been off since March

runners.name: Super Hit
runners.spotlight: All the better for a hood returning, winning two of his last three races; overcame some traffic issues to prevail narrowly at Windsor 12 days ago (1m2f, good to firm); 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Overcame some traffic issues to win narrowly at Windsor 12 days ago

runners.name: Whiskey Pete
runners.spotlight: Only 1-27, the win when with Ralph Beckett; had been badly out of form this season but ran better in a new tongue-tie over 1m here last time when close up behind Mariner; possibilities if as good again as he stays this far.
runners.comment: Ran better in a new tongue-tie over 1m here last time when close up behind Mariner

runners.name: Steps In Time
runners.spotlight: Has shown some fair Flat form but became disappointing for David O'Meara and has shown nothing over hurdles for current yard.
runners.comment: Became disappointing for David O'Meara and nothing over hurdles for current yard

runners.name: Cosmos Raj
runners.spotlight: Won at Ripon (1m, soft) last July off a mark 12lb higher than today's but he's struggled since; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Won at Ripon last July off a mark 12lb higher than today's but he's struggled since

runners.name: Vidmiyr
runners.spotlight: 7f maiden winner in May and held his own in handicaps until a poor last run, since when he's been gelded; entitled to play a part if back to best.
runners.comment: Held his own in handicaps until a poor last run, since when he's been gelded
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: First Time
runners.spotlight: Newmarket maiden winner for Harry Charlton last August (6f, good to firm); subsequently sold for 90,000gns; building momentum in handicaps for his new yard, last time holding every chance over C&D and going down by a length; solid prospects off 1lb lower.
runners.comment: Maiden winner last year and building momentum in handicaps for his new yard

runners.name: Haaderr
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up before winning a 7f AW maiden in October and then gelded; finished last of the four when favourite for his handicap debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm) but he raced freely up front and didn't look at home on the track; worth another chance.
runners.comment: Maiden winner; there are reasons for forgiving him a disappointing handicap debut

runners.name: Goldwork
runners.spotlight: Goodwood novice winner in May of last year; 0-9 in the meantime and progress has levelled out; ran no more than okay when third of five in a new tongue-tie last week at Lingfield (6f, good to firm); swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers here.
runners.comment: Ran no more than okay when third of five in a new tongue-tie last week; blinkers added

runners.name: Suspicious Mindz
runners.spotlight: Bought for 50,000gns soon after winning a 6f Curragh maiden in first-time cheekpieces (eighth start); proven over 1m, let alone this far, and could be interesting on yard/handicap debut.
runners.comment: Bought for 50,000gns soon after winning a 6f Curragh maiden in first-time cheekpieces

runners.name: Shadow Run
runners.spotlight: 0-7 in Ireland with one notable effort when narrowly beaten in a 5f handicap at Naas in March (first-time blinkers); struggled in two following runs, the latest tried in a visor; changed hands for 5,500gns; likely best watched.
runners.comment: One effort of note in Ireland before losing his way; changed hands for 5,500gns
runners.owner: L Bond, Sheikh Aymen Al Hamandi, J Catling

runners.name: Hares Bredth
runners.spotlight: Made the most of a favourable draw, running down the pacesetter at Redcar (6f, good; from 4lb lower) in June; below that level at Thirsk, but this is easier, and Jake Dickson's 5lb claim is handy; stamina is untested beyond 6f.
runners.comment: Redcar winner (6f) penultimate start; Jake Dickson's 5lb claim is handy; stamina for 7f?

runners.name: Emerald Army
runners.spotlight: Started off well for Ruth Carr, although did appear to throw away (hung right) a winning opportunity when runner-up at Carlisle (7f, good) in May; better than bare facts - denied a clear run - when sixth of nine at Thirsk latest; fairly treated, so isn't discounted.
runners.comment: Better than bare facts (denied a clear run) when sixth at Thirsk latest; isn't discounted.

runners.name: Moonhall Lass
runners.spotlight: Overcame slow start to win in newly applied visor at Leicester (7f; from 3lb lower) on penultimate start; less productive (fourth of five) back there over 6f subsequently; cheekpieces refitted, and Christian Howarth's 3lb claim can assist.
runners.comment: Won in newly applied visor at Leicester (7f) on penultimate start; fourth over 6f since.

runners.name: Operation Gimcrack
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner, including from this mark at Newcastle (7f) in February; is yet to win on turf (0-13) but was beaten a nose in this last year, and was returning from a ten-week break when sixth of ten at Redcar (7f; 50-1; beaten 10l) in June; others preferred.
runners.comment: Yet to win on turf (0-13); sixth of ten at Redcar (7f; 50-1) in June; others preferred.

runners.name: Sparkling Pink
runners.spotlight: 1-12; placed over C&D in April, and gave it a good go from the front when third to Vega's Virtue at Ripon (1m, good) a fortnight ago; sports newly applied cheekpieces seeking that extra edge with the drop back to 7f in her favour; chance.
runners.comment: Gave it good go when third at Ripon (1m, good) a fortnight ago; cheekpieces on; 7f a plus.

runners.name: Get Up Everybody
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; forced to switch right - circumnavigated the field - when third of 11 at Ripon (6f, good; 11-4 favourite) a fortnight ago; worth another go over 7f (first since debut) as he seeks to make the breakthrough; likely player.
runners.comment: Circumnavigated field when third of 11 at Ripon (6f, good; 11-4 fav) latest; back to 7f.

runners.name: Havana Oaks
runners.spotlight: 0-4; failed to take step forward on Ripon handicap debut (6f; seventh of nine, 28-1; always towards rear); still early days but, equally, there's little to suggest that she can play a role in the finish.
runners.comment: Failed to take a step forward on Ripon handicap debut (6f; seventh, 28-1); easy to swerve.

runners.name: Danrana
runners.spotlight: Modest in maidens, the pick of her three starts coming on Catterick debut (7f, soft; fourth, beaten nearly 7l) last July; has been given a nine-week break since low-key Chester comeback; hood applied for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Given a nine-week break since low-key Chester comeback; hood applied for handicap debut.

runners.name: Ryefield
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; has plummeted in the weights since sent handicapping (down 16lb); weakened quickly when last of eight in first-time cheekpieces at Wetherby (5.5f) latest; difficult to identify many positives; headgear tweaked.
runners.comment: Weakened quickly when last of eight at Wetherby (5.5f) latest run; headgear tweaked.

runners.name: Arnaz
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 24 starts came at Brighton (7f, good; from 9lb higher) in May 2024; generally disappointing for this trainer, weakening on first start since wind surgery at Ffos Las (7.5f, good; beaten over 7l) 32 days ago; 3lb lower.
runners.comment: 1-24; weakened on first start since wind surgery at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) 32 days ago.

runners.name: Queensmaite
runners.spotlight: Ran well (third) on Southwell debut (5f maiden; 33-1) last April, but it's been all downhill since, beating only a single rival in two AW starts this year; cheekpieces discarded off 95-day break for turf return; monitor only.
runners.comment: Beat only a single rival in two AW starts this year; cheekpieces discarded for turf return

runners.name: Von Trotter
runners.spotlight: 0-8; no match for Act Of Violence at Ripon (6f, good; 10-1) a fortnight ago, but that was a step back in the right direction, and third-placed Get Up Everybody puts that form to the test in the first division (4:50); key player on first attempt at 7f (dam a 7f-8.4f winner).
runners.comment: 0-8; step back in right direction at Ripon (6f) latest; on the shortlist now tackling 7f.

runners.name: Wilde And Dandy
runners.spotlight: 2-5 over C&D; scrambled home to justify favouritism from Operation Gimcrack (runs in first division) in this last year; placed numerous times since, including at Yarmouth (7f; 10-1) on penultimate start; slow start scuppered chance latest.
runners.comment: Scrambled home to justify favouritism from Operation Gimcrack in this last year; 1lb lower

runners.name: Sir David
runners.spotlight: Modest since joining Nigel Tinkler (0-6) but there was merit to his Carlisle second (7f, soft) on penultimate start; that track seems to bring out the best of his abilities so, although fairly weighted, he couldn't rate as a confident pick.
runners.comment: Modest since joining this yard; some merit to his Carlisle second (7f, soft) penultimate.

runners.name: Donald
runners.spotlight: 0-7; respectable comeback at Nottingham (5f, good; fourth, beaten 3l) in May, but hasn't built on that, including in blinkers (discarded) the last twice; tough to say how he'll fare on first go at 7f; safer options elsewhere.
runners.comment: 0-7; hasn't built on respectable Nottingham comeback fourth; stamina questionable at 7f.

runners.name: Magic Lady Mae
runners.spotlight: 0-7; onto third trainer already, having previously been with Richard Hannon and Kevin/Lauren Frost; minor headway when sixth on recent stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f; 22-1); down a further 5lb in the weights.
runners.comment: Minor headway when sixth on recent stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f AW; 22-1); down 5lb.
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Mister McGregor
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden; placed in this same headgear combination at Wolverhampton and Chester (both 7f) before producing poor performance at Chester latest; opposed on the balance of probability.
runners.comment: 27-race maiden; poor performance at Chester latest; opposed on the balance of probability.

runners.name: Groundsman
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on turf (0-12); hasn't managed to beat many rivals in three starts this year, only eighth of nine at Catterick (7f; 28-1) 24 days ago; handicap mark continues to slide.
runners.comment: Yet to win on turf (0-12); hasn't managed to beat many rivals in three starts this year.

runners.name: Barbuda Bay
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden; lost shoe when failing to figure (11 of 14) on handicap debut at Bath (1m; 25-1) seven weeks ago; 2lb lower in the right type of race, but with clear improvement required to threaten.
runners.comment: Lost shoe when failing to figure (11th) on handicap debut at Bath (1m; 25-1); 2lb lower.

runners.name: Back From Dubai
runners.spotlight: Finished strongly to resume winning ways over C&D (good to soft; from 2lb lower) in May; hasn't operated at the same level since, but overall strike rate (10-80) is admirable for the level; forecast ground perhaps faster than ideal.
runners.comment: Finished strongly to score over C&D (2lb lower) in May; not operated at same level since.

runners.name: Sprinting Speed
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; in rear throughout in newly applied headgear combination (discarded) over 6f here five weeks ago; eased another 3lb in the handicap since, so isn't written off yet; prudent to consult the market.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; headgear experiment ceased; isn't written off yet, consult the market.

runners.name: Startled Lady
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough, justifying favouritism at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago; while she has responded to the removal of the hood, this represents a step back up the ladder (Class 5) from a 4lb higher mark; her task isn't an insurmountable one, though.
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm; 5-2 fav); 4lb higher back in Class 5.

runners.name: Celtic Arrow
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who is continuing to make progress; runner-up on her last two starts, latest when a neck behind Saucy Jane on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f; good to firm; 20-1); 1lb higher in a slightly more competitive contest but can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Low mileage; neck behind Saucy Jane on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f; good to firm) latest.

runners.name: Come On Over
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck over C&D in June; made amends the following week before his revised mark could kick into force, making all to fend off a pair of rivals who also raced far side early on in that contest; weakened quickly when last of four at Nottingham latest; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: C&D winner (from 4lb lower); weakened quickly in four-runner contest at Nottingham since.
runners.owner: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd

runners.name: Another Investment
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on last two starts, beaten a nose at Carlisle (6f, good; 5-2 favourite) four weeks ago; that form looks solid, with the winner running well in a Class 4 at York subsequently; 1lb higher, but does have Alex Jary's 3lb claim to assist; key player.
runners.comment: Beaten a nose at Carlisle (6f, good; 5-2 fav) four weeks ago; that looks solid; 1lb higher

runners.name: Ay Gee Ell
runners.spotlight: 1-21; close fourth at Thirsk (6f, good; from 7lb higher) in April; has lost his way since, failing to beat many in 5f contests at Pontefract, Beverley, and Chester; questions to be answered for the time being.
runners.comment: 1-21; fourth at Thirsk (6f) in April; lost way since; easing mark isn't enough to tempt.

runners.name: Shazani
runners.spotlight: Won the Legends Classified Stakes here (1m; 40-1) last September; knocking on the door over 7f here (23) in recent times; competitively weighted from an unchanged mark, and a danger to all if allowed uncontested lead back at 6f.
runners.comment: Knocking on door over 7f here (23) recently; competitively weighted from an unchanged mark

runners.name: Ziggy's Condor
runners.spotlight: No turf win since July 2023; ran respectably (fifth) on stable debut at Yarmouth (7f, good) in May and has had excuses since, including when stumbling and unseating his rider at the start at Goodwood on Wednesday; 3lb below last winning mark (AW), and with a 5lb claimer booked.
runners.comment: Ran respectably (fifth) on stable debut at Yarmouth (7f, good) in May; excuses since.

runners.name: Mark's Choice
runners.spotlight: Ripon specialist (ten wins at that track); run down only by Reigning Profit and Rock Of England when attempting to win the race named in his honour there (5f) 26 days ago; no issue with this return to 6f and has been placed here previously.
runners.comment: Ripon specialist; run down only late there (5f) 26 days ago; has placed form at this track

races.race_name: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Henley On Thames
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in fast-ground maidens at Brighton (5.5f) and Yarmouth (5f) on last two starts; sets a fair standard and shapes as if 6f could suit.
runners.comment: Runner-up last twice and 6f should be within range; sets the standard

runners.name: Bearing Gifts
runners.spotlight: 200,000euros breeze-up purchase out of a mare who failed to win herself but is from a good family; betting informative for stable which enjoys plenty of first-time-out 2yo success.
runners.comment: Cost 200,000euros at breeze-ups and would need considering if betting vibes are strong

runners.name: California School
runners.spotlight: 140,000gns breeze-up purchase who never threatened when sixth of ten on Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, but looked to be getting the hang of things late and improvement is very much on cards; Tuesday's Goodwood maiden winner Agrippa was second so it was probably a decent race.
runners.comment: Showed promise with late headway on recent Newbury debut; sure to improve

runners.name: Polymer
runners.spotlight: Space Blues half-brother to 6f/7f AW 2yo winner Ghisa (RPR 77); dam unraced half-sister to some useful sorts; yard had an easy 2yo winner here (although not first time up) in June so a market move would be interesting.
runners.comment: Check betting on debut for yard which had easy 2yo winner here in June

runners.name: Thanks Harry
runners.spotlight: Harry Angel colt who was sent off at 33-1 and finished well held on his Ascot debut three weeks ago.
runners.comment: 33-1 when well held on his Ascot debut three weeks ago

races.race_name: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: According To Mark
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in all three starts this year, the latest behind a nice sort (just beaten in a Goodwood handicap on Wednesday) at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm; first start since being gelded) last month; big shout, especially if the cheekpieces have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Runner-up in all three starts this year, the latest behind a nice sort; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Tiernan
runners.spotlight: Form has been up and down, but one of his better efforts when beaten a neck in a Pontefract maiden (1m2f, good) last month; solid claims granted a similar effort.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck in a Pontefract maiden last month; solid claims granted a similar effort

runners.name: Midnight Serenade
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Earn Your Stripes (5f/6f; RPR 59) and Willy Il Coyote (Italian 6.7f-1m); dam 1m4f AW winner (58), half-sister to US 8.5f stakes winner Lilbourne Eliza and Listed-placed 1m/1m2f winner Terre Neuve; hooded on debut and wouldn't be an obvious winner first time out; refused to enter the stalls for her intended debut at Carlisle in June.
runners.comment: Hooded on debut and wouldn't be an obvious winner first time out

runners.name: Kissmehoneyhoney
runners.spotlight: Overcame greenness when narrowly making a winning debut at Leicester (1m2f, good to soft) last September, but although only beating one home in a Listed contest at Goodwood (1m4f, good) in May, she did meet trouble; respected if resuming her progress.
runners.comment: Leicester winner last year and met trouble on reappearance; respected if resuming progress

runners.name: Sottsfield
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced when fourth of five in a Chester maiden (1m2f, good; 150-1) in May, but he still has a bit to find and looks one for handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Not disgraced last time, but has a bit to find and looks one for handicaps after this

runners.name: High Point
runners.spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June, since when he changed hands for 19,000gns; 4lb rise fair enough, but he could do with some rain; one of two runners for yard that took this in 2024.
runners.comment: Changed stables since winning at Yarmouth in June; could do with some rain

runners.name: Gentle Warrior
runners.spotlight: Edging back down the weights and now 3lb higher than for the latest of two wins over 1m6f last September; wore cheekpieces in a void race last month, but this is effectively his first start in them; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than for the latest of two wins over 1m6f last September; shortlisted
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXV & E Burke

runners.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Coped well with step up in trip when winning narrowly at York (1m4f, good) in June; fourth of five when favourite over this C&D (good) three weeks ago but she was beaten only just over a length in a muddling contest; this should be run at a truer pace and she is highly respected.
runners.comment: Unexposed as a stayer; should have this run to suit her better than C&D race last time

runners.name: Secret Force
runners.spotlight: 2-5 since joining this yard, winning at Pontefract (2m2f, good; first-time visor) in June and over hurdles at Cartmel a fortnight ago; clearly in good heart, but this may not be far enough for him now.
runners.comment: 2-5 since joining this yard; in good heart, but this may not be far enough for him now

runners.name: Eroico
runners.spotlight: 0-8; finished fourth of 15 on her third start for the yard at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm; 50-1) last time, but was still 15l behind the winner; another 2lb drop not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: 0-8; finished fourth of 15 at Carlisle last time, but was still 15l behind the winner

runners.name: Cabrera
