runners.spotlight: Out of her depth in Listed company at Pontefract (1m4f, good) 15 days ago, but suggested she retains ability after returning from another lengthy absence in March; return to a longer trip may suit and respected down in grade.
runners.comment: Still retains ability; return to a longer trip may suit and respected down in grade
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing 1 And Mrs David Egan

runners.name: Gallus Norman
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who won at Musselburgh (2m, good) in May and Ayr (1m7f, soft) in June; however, he seemed to find the trip too sharp over C&D (good) in between and ran poorly over 2m when favourite at Musselburgh on Friday.
runners.comment: Two 2026 wins but seemed to find this trip too sharp in between and ran poorly yesterday

runners.name: Wootton's Gal
runners.spotlight: Beaten upwards of 10l in three maidens over 7f-1m4f; from a highly successful staying family and worth a market check on handicap debut.
runners.comment: From a highly successful staying family and worth a market check on handicap debut

runners.name: Cotton Bud
runners.spotlight: Made a successful stable debut/reappearance at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in April, but a 5lb rise seemed to find her out at York (1m4f, good) the following month; bred to stay this far, but she needs to bounce back after 79 days off.
runners.comment: Made a successful reappearance, but held next time; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Ouro Preto
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m3f/1m4f on a soft surface in France, but he hasn't beaten many in five starts for this yard; down another 3lb, but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Hasn't beaten many in five starts for this yard; down another 3lb, but hard to fancy

runners.name: Spanish Hustle
runners.spotlight: Six of his eight wins have come over 1m3f/1m4f here and is 6lb lower than for the most recent, but yet to click since returning in May; dual-handed stable won this in 2022 and 2023.
runners.comment: Six of his eight wins have come here, but yet to click since returning in May

runners.name: Manila Scouse
runners.spotlight: Running well this year, including close third to Vantheman over C&D in May, and he posted a deserved win in a big field at Ayr (6f, good) 26 days ago; raised 5lb but he was very competitive off similar marks in 2024.
runners.comment: Gained reward for some good efforts this year when winning in big field at Ayr latest

runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.spotlight: Perked up by first-time cheekpieces (retained) when making all at Ayr (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago, his first win since taking this in 2024; put back up 4lb but his 2024 success came off 10lb higher so he has obvious handicapping scope if the headgear works again.
runners.comment: Ended losing run with cheekpieces added latest; remains well treated on old form
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Fluorescence
runners.spotlight: Largely progressive form; ran a cracker on what was effectively her seasonal return (unseated her rider soon after start on reappearance) when fourth of 15 in 5f Ayr Listed race (soft) in June; travelled strongly close to the pace in 6f York Group 3 (good to firm) since and the return to 5f could suit back in handicap company; part of a strong hand for Ed Bethell.
runners.comment: Faded late in 6f York Group 3 latest and drop back to 5f promises to suit; respected

runners.name: Corolla Point
runners.spotlight: Won 5f handicaps at Haydock (good) and here (soft) on his first two runs for Ed Bethell last September; has recorded even better form in defeat this year, notably his close second of 14 in the Gosforth Park Cup (5f) five weeks ago; won't be inconvenienced should any of the forecast showers arrive; gets the vote.
runners.comment: Progressive C&D scorer who is taken to resume winning ways on back of good second latest

runners.name: Arklow Lad
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-5 since joining Mick Appleby when seeing off 19 rivals in the Epsom Dash (5f, good to soft) eight weeks ago; had the advantage of racing against the near rail but most of his 6lb rise is offset by the promising Conor Whiteley's claim.
runners.comment: Aided by good track position when winning Dash at Epsom but he's thriving for new yard

runners.name: Vantheman
runners.spotlight: Back in form since fitted with blinkers, scoring over C&D (good) in May; has reached the frame on all three outings since, although latest fourth of seven at Pontefract was no more than respectable.
runners.comment: Reacted well to blinkers; won over C&D in May and reached the frame all three runs since

runners.name: Parisiac
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D (good) on seasonal return; good runner-up efforts on next two starts but below par at Ayr latest; suspicion he'll be vulnerable in this higher grade.
runners.comment: In good form until below par at Ayr latest; this is higher grade than he usually contests

runners.name: Fivethousandtoone
runners.spotlight: He is a better horse on AW than turf; a much lower mark in this sphere reflects that but his 1-28 record on the grass doesn't mark him down as the likely winner of this.
runners.comment: Has a falling mark on turf but his 1-28 record in this sphere suggests it's warranted

runners.name: Eternal Sunshine
runners.spotlight: Won last season's Portland handicap at Doncaster (good) off a 2lb higher mark; looked on the way back when runner-up back at Doncaster early last month but two lesser runs have followed.
runners.comment: Looked on the way back when second last month but two lesser runs have followed

runners.name: Venture Capital
runners.spotlight: Below par in three AW outings this year and a return to turf and first-time blinkers failed to spark a revival at Beverley in April; absent since (has had wind surgery for a second time).
runners.comment: Below par earlier in year and hopes pinned on wind op sparking a revival

runners.name: Canon's House
runners.spotlight: Four wins last season, including C&D on good; 0-6 in 2026 but latest Southwell third creditable and he's back on a winning mark.
runners.comment: C&D scorer last year; latest AW third creditable and he's on a winning mark
runners.owner: M McHale, J Munroe, M Guy & D Walshe

runners.name: Purosangue
runners.spotlight: He hasn't won since a Listed success at York (6f, soft) in October 2023, but he's started for Robert Cowell with a trio of creditable efforts in competitive handicaps; could click for this yard at some point.
runners.comment: No win since autumn 2023 but started out for Robert Cowell with three creditable efforts

runners.name: Another Baar
runners.spotlight: Landed a 5f Bahrain handicap in January but has struggled since; the handicapper is starting to relent but others are still preferred.
runners.comment: Has struggled since Bahrain win in January; likely best to look elsewhere again

runners.name: Solar Aclaim
runners.spotlight: Back to form to take advantage of a reduced mark over (good to soft) in June; well beaten at Chester since but a revival isn't ruled out if the ground is on the soft side (all six wins gained on going softer than good).
runners.comment: C&D win in June; goes well on softer than good and considered if ground eases

runners.name: Little Mi Mi
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-10 on the AW when successful at Newcastle last month; up 5lb and 1-13 on turf, but a stiff 5f seems to suit her well; looks the pick of the stable's trio.
runners.comment: Best on the AW, but a stiff 5f seems to suit her well; looks the pick of the stable's trio
runners.owner: N Irving, F Steele & I Jardine

runners.name: Jm Jhingree
runners.spotlight: 2-5 over C&D, the latest win coming in first-time cheekpieces in June (good to firm, has won on soft); still just 2lb higher, but not the most consistent; first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: 2-5 over C&D, the latest win coming in June, but not the most consistent; blinkers on

runners.name: Hundred Caps
runners.spotlight: Has been consistent since his successful reappearance at Southwell (6f, AW) in January and was only beaten 2l into fourth of eight in a 0-85 at Beverley last month; suited by a stiff 5f and much respected down in class.
runners.comment: Consistent sort; suited by a stiff 5f and much respected down in class

runners.name: Harb
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when winning at Carlisle (5f, good) in May, but not very consistent so not quite sure what to expect.
runners.comment: Back off last winning mark, but not very consistent so not quite sure what to expect

runners.name: Iris Dancer
runners.spotlight: Holds her form really well despite being kept busy, winning three times here since mid-June and making it 12 course wins overall; the return here is a big plus, but all 14 career wins have come over 6f so she does have something to prove on a rare attempt at 5f; stable also runs Harb.
runners.comment: All 14 career wins have come over 6f including 12 here; 5f a question mark

runners.name: Thunderstorm Katie
runners.spotlight: One of five wins in the second half of last season was over C&D in August; four seconds (including over 5f/6f here) from the back in her last five starts this term, back to form at Musselburgh last night; each-way claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner; four seconds in her last five starts, latest at Musselburgh last night

runners.name: Oriental Prince
runners.spotlight: Another who has a better strike-rate on AW (7-19) than on turf (1-17); patchy form so far this year, but has dropped 3lb below his last winning mark and this is a drop in class; stable also runs Thunderstorm Katie.
runners.comment: Patchy form this year, but 3lb below his last winning mark and this is a drop in class

runners.name: Never Dark
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 16, but has won twice over C&D and ran better than it looked when sixth of 11 at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) 11 days ago; 20lb below his last winning mark and could go well at a price.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; 20lb below his last winning mark and could go well at a price

runners.name: King's Crown
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on the AW (4-26) than on turf (3-39); 4lb below his last winning mark, but has to put a modest effort at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last month behind him.
runners.comment: 4lb below last winning mark, but has a to put a modest effort at Ayr last month behind him

runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: 1lb below his last winning mark, but is another who would have made more appeal on the AW (5-10) than turf (1-40).
runners.comment: 1lb below last winning mark, but would have made more appeal on AW (5-10) than turf (1-40)

runners.name: Tiriac
runners.spotlight: 1lb below his last winning mark but usually misses the break and has finished out of the frame in all five starts this year; rain would help.
runners.comment: Has finished out of the frame in all five starts this year; rain would help

runners.name: Mwafaq
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who scored over C&D (good to soft) in June before making it five wins in his last seven starts when overcoming interference to shade a close finish at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) four weeks ago; he and the second were clear of the rest on Town Moor so a 4lb rise may not stop him.
runners.comment: Has won five of last seven (including C&D) and could still be a step ahead of handicapper
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Sanafi Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Ex-German 1m1f winner; gained a first win for current yard over C&D (good to firm) in May and has matched that form when third here on his last two starts; likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: C&D win in May and third here last twice; likely to be on the premises again

runners.name: Ephron
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo whose form since handicapping features a reappearance win at Redcar (1m) in April and keeping-on second at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in June; beaten by more than lack of stamina over 1m2f at Pontefract since, though.
runners.comment: In good form at the start of the summer but need to forgive poor run last time
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxvi And P Demilow

runners.name: Intrusively
runners.spotlight: Good and bad in six runs for this yard, failing to build on a decent run at Newcastle when seventh of eight at Doncaster last time.
runners.comment: In and out for this yard, posting a lesser run last time

runners.name: Starliner
runners.spotlight: Course winner who added to his tally at Ayr (1m, good to firm) in May; good runner-up efforts there in recent weeks and has to enter calculations.
runners.comment: C&D winner who arrives on back of good seconds at Ayr last month
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Midsummer Storm
runners.spotlight: Cost 550,000euros as a 2yo but has yet to make a significant impact, including last of six on 7.5f Beverley handicap debut (good) 39 days ago; much too soon to write him off for leading stable but first-time cheekpieces need to give him a lift.
runners.comment: Last of six on handicap debut; too soon to write off but cheekpieces need to give him lift

runners.name: Rajapour
runners.spotlight: Had been bubbling under prior to winning easily at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last month; keeping on (although still had a fair bit of ground to make up) when clipping heels and coming down 1f out at York last Saturday; 9lb higher than at Redcar but still a potential class act at this level if that nasty experience last weekend hasn't left a mark.
runners.comment: Potential class act in this 0-75 if none the worse for his fall last weekend

runners.name: Watcha Snoop
runners.spotlight: Landed 6f Ascot novice (soft) for Hugo Palmer last September; little to shout about since but his mark has tumbled as a result and Adam Nicol does well with new recruits (same owners); one to keep an eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: Has a series of duck eggs but joined yard which does well with new recruits

runners.name: Yaaser
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on his 2025 form but has yet to really get going this time round, including beaten 5l when third of six at Ayr (7f) 12 days ago; Paul Mulrennan, who has been on board for eight of his ten wins, is on Sanafi Zabeel this time.
runners.comment: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on 2025 form but yet to really get going this year

runners.name: Sunriseontheboyne
runners.spotlight: Won his final start in Ireland (1m, heavy); hasn't been in the same form for new stable but worth a second look in the betting back from a two-month break.
runners.comment: Yet to fire for new yard but worth a betting check back from a short break
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

runners.name: Pisanello
runners.spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick after two wins on good to firm ground at Redcar, the latest in an apprentice handicap over 1m under Conor Whiteley on Wednesday; can race off 1lb lower and shouldn't have an issue with stepping back up trip, while rain would also be no problem; major claims.
runners.comment: 1lb lower in his bid for a hat-trick; goes on all ground and holds major claims

runners.name: Evelyn's Phoenix
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as for his successful Nottingham reappearance (1m, good) in April, but his form has regressed since; enough to prove.
runners.comment: Back off last winning mark, but his form has become regressive; enough to prove

runners.name: Can I Kiss You
runners.spotlight: 0-12; made a promising reappearance when second of 15 at Gowran Park (1m, good to yielding) in May, but below that level since including in both starts for this yard; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: 0-12 and below form lately, including in both starts for this yard

runners.name: Ring Of Gold
runners.spotlight: 5-37 on the AW but 0-24 on turf; hasn't looked like exploiting his declining mark of late; visor returns.
runners.comment: 0-24 on turf and hasn't looked like exploiting his declining mark of late

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: Has twice made the frame over 6f this year, but 0-13 and has plenty to prove on this first attempt beyond 7f.
runners.comment: 0-13 and has plenty to prove on this first attempt beyond 7f

runners.name: Hostelry
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over the extended 1m here; losing run up to 13, but 16lb below her last winning mark and looked unlucky not to finish closer when fourth of six here (1m, good) three weeks ago; stays this far and could go well.
runners.comment: Losing run now 13 but 16lb below last winning mark and ran better than it looked last time

runners.name: Defence Missile
runners.spotlight: Made it 15th-time lucky at Newcastle (1m, AW) a week ago; now needs to show he can do it back on turf from 4lb higher and also still has stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Made it 15th-time lucky at Newcastle a week ago; needs to show he can do it back on turf

runners.name: Braes Of Doune
runners.spotlight: Mainly campaigned over shorter but does stay this far; 399 days off before this season; never-never fourth of seven at Musselburgh (7f) last night was probably his most positive display since; back on his last winning mark.
runners.comment: On last winning mark; last night's 4th was probably his most positive display this term

runners.name: Jenson Benson
runners.spotlight: All four wins have come on the AW at Chelmsford (7f-1m2f) and is 0-11 on turf; plenty to prove on his return from ten months off with cheekpieces given a go.
runners.comment: 0-11 on turf; plenty to prove on his return from ten months off; cheekpieces on

races.race_name: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Bintknight
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who won small-field C&D (good) maiden in May, her second start, and was creditable second on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) last month; still has more improvement to come; good chance.
runners.comment: Won C&D maiden in May and was second on handicap debut; still has more to offer

runners.name: Starlight Time
runners.spotlight: 2-3 as a 2yo; not much has gone to plan on his two starts this year but he had soft ground as a plausible excuse for 56l defeat at Epsom (1m2f) on Derby Derby, and his down-the-field finish at Ascot (1m; first-time hood) last month came in a warm 3yo handicap; this race is easier and it would be dangerous to write him off at this stage.
runners.comment: 2-3 as a 2yo; not much has gone to plan this season but he can't be written off just yet

runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his Group 3 win at Glorious Goodwood three years ago but placed several times this year, losing out only by a neck at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) on latest outing 16 days ago; remains on a workable mark and will be fine over today's shorter trip; probably on the premises again.
runners.comment: Placed several times this year, losing out only by a neck at Epsom (1m4f) last month

runners.name: Londoner
runners.spotlight: Won off today's mark on Polytrack here (1m2f) in April; not quite at same level on turf since but was persistently denied clear run when fourth of six at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; behind Percival) nine days ago and has possibilities if his luck improves.
runners.comment: AW winner off this mark here in April; denied clear run when fourth on turf last week

runners.name: Percival
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since heavy-ground win on debut in France in November 2024 but bettered low-key stable debut when respectable third at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; hood removed) nine days ago, despite racing too freely; any further progress here will make him a serious player.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 4yo; bettered low-key stable debut when third at Sandown last week; player

races.race_name: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes

runners.name: Zafaan
runners.spotlight: Below form in 1m2f Yarmouth handicap last month (no headgear) but returned to the Flat with win in refitted cheekpieces (back on today) over that C&D (good to firm) in June and has strong claims if back at that level.
runners.comment: Below form last month but won in this grade at Yarmouth in June; likely contender

runners.name: Private Project
runners.spotlight: Kept on for third in AW handicap here (1m2f) in March but was well down the field on both subsequent starts (1m4f/1m2f) and is now 0-9; eased in grade but needs three-month break to have done her good.
runners.comment: 0-9; given three-month break after two down-the-field runs; eased in grade

runners.name: Lapidarist
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden; placed in two AW handicaps in early part of this year (1m/9.4f) but beaten about 16l when fourth of five on turf return at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in June; must do better here.
runners.comment: Placed twice on AW in early part of year but well held on turf return in June

runners.name: Panthere Noir
runners.spotlight: 0-16 but made brave bold from the front before weakening into third at Epsom (1m4f, good) last month and faced impossible task when second of four behind well-handicapped rival here (1m6f, good to firm) a week ago; ought to be suited by this drop back in trip; dangerous if allowed to dominate.
runners.comment: 0-16 but both runs last month were respectable and this drop back in trip ought to suit

runners.name: Cormorant Rock
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced after only five starts and wasn't disgraced when fifth of seven in this grade at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) last month but needs to take another step forward.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in this grade at Yarmouth last month but needs to find something extra

runners.name: Ruiz
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six starts, the penultimate over C&D in this grade; significant improvement required.
runners.comment: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six starts, the penultimate over C&D in this grade

runners.name: Campeona
runners.spotlight: Much improved since hiked up in trip and switched to handicaps this season, and bids to complete a hat-trick after small-field success in first-time cheekpieces at Newbury (2m, good to firm) nine days ago; has an ungainly head carriage but is probably still well treated after latest 4lb rise.
runners.comment: 2-3 since hiked upped in trip and switched to handicaps; probably still well treated

runners.name: Laravie
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row in a visor this spring (1m6f-2m1f, good to firm/good) but recent efforts suggest the handicapper may have her measure now; tried in blinkers here; needs to kick on again.
runners.comment: Won three in a row in a visor this spring; handicapper may have her measure now

runners.name: An Bradan Feasa
runners.spotlight: Clear second to fast-improving rival over C&D (good) on latest Flat start in June and also ran well over hurdles last month; may not have much margin for error off current mark but can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Clear second to fast-improving rival over C&D on latest Flat start; can make presence felt

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Rogue Exile
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed-placed German winner; showed inexperience in early stages but ran on well for clear second of five (no threat to winner) on last month's debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm); ought to be more streetwise here; leading contender.
runners.comment: Ran on well for clear second once penny dropped on debut at Yarmouth (7f) last month

runners.name: Malakai Kite
runners.spotlight: Displayed promise on first three starts, most notably when third over C&D (good) in May; has a bit to find on the figures with a couple of these but can collect another minor prize; hooded for first time.
runners.comment: Has a bit to find on the figures but was placed over C&D in May; minor prize possible

runners.name: Call Alert
runners.spotlight: Struggled (albeit on soft ground) on debut here (7.6f) in June and didn't achieve much when last of five at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) last month; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Well held on first two starts and difficult to enthuse over.

runners.name: Justice Court
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo winner Gavota; made quite promising debut when keeping-on third of ten at Kempton (6f, AW) in December; gelded during subsequent eight-month break and has tongue-tie fitted for turf debut; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Absent since promising 6f AW debut in December but still goes on the shortlist

runners.name: Dayna
runners.spotlight: Beaten over 15l when last of five on last month's debut at Ripon (1m, good); not the most obvious answer here.
runners.comment: Beaten over 15l when last of five on last month's debut at Ripon (1m)

runners.name: Knock Three Times
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) on nursery debut 17 days ago, beating the warm favourite; could still be well treated after recent 3lb rise; obvious contender.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D on recent nursery debut and could still be well treated after 3lb rise

runners.name: Miss Moneypit
runners.spotlight: Won here when dropped back to 5f (good to firm) for recent nursery debut; could quite plausibly have more to offer back at 6f but is 5lb higher in a higher-grade race today.
runners.comment: Won here when dropped back to 5f for recent nursery debut; up in grade today

runners.name: Seed Ya Later
runners.spotlight: Safely held when sixth of seven on last month's nursery debut at Nottingham but subsequent seventh of 24 in Newbury's Super Sprint (also 5f, good to firm; first-time hood) was commendable, particularly as she was first of seven home in the far-side group; can feature if suited by this new trip.
runners.comment: Back in calmer waters after commendable seventh of 24 in Newbury's Super Sprint

runners.name: Il Capo
runners.spotlight: Only beaten about 2l when fifth of six on recent nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) and is 2lb lower here but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Only beaten about 2l when fifth of six on recent nursery debut but others look stronger

runners.name: Laylaty
runners.spotlight: Built upon encouraging debut when third of ten in Newbury novice (6f, good to firm) last month, despite racing too freely, and should have more improvement to come in nurseries; must be considered.
runners.comment: Placed in Newbury novice last month; can improve again in nurseries

runners.name: Rogue Imperial
runners.spotlight: Creditable third behind two useful rivals in valuable C&D (good) novice in June and had excuse when well beaten on latest outing (struck into); needs to be taken very seriously on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Creditable third behind useful rivals in C&D novice in June; respected on nursery debut

runners.name: Seathegulls
runners.spotlight: Behind Seed Ya Later when tenth of 24 in Newbury's Super Sprint (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now been unplaced all four starts; needs combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces to unlock improvement on this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Has shown ability but needs combination of new trip and cheekpieces to prompt improvement

runners.name: Jackson Street
runners.spotlight: Has modest 2-39 strike-rate, with both wins gained on AW, and tends to race too freely but the form of his never-dangerous fourth at Brighton (7f, good to firm) at end of June has worked out well; worth a second look.
runners.comment: 0-12 on turf but form of never-dangerous fourth at Brighton in June has worked out well

runners.name: Beau Jardine
runners.spotlight: Ended long losing run with soft-ground C&D win in June and gave another good account when fourth at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Soft-ground C&D winner in June and also ran on fast ground at Salisbury 11 days ago

runners.name: Musical Soldier
runners.spotlight: Close second twice on good to firm turf last month before winning in first-time cheekpieces on Tapeta (also 7f) 11 days ago; 5lb higher here but commands respect in current form; usual tongue-tie (left off last time) is refitted.
runners.comment: Close second twice on fast turf before recent Tapeta win; respected in current mood

runners.name: Creciente
runners.spotlight: Came good at 11th attempt, with clearcut win from off the pace in C&D (good to firm) classified ten days ago; has more on her plate in this handicap but further progress is possible.
runners.comment: Up in grade after clearcut C&D classified win last month but further progress is possible

runners.name: Fulford Cross
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three turf starts, most recently in soft-ground C&D contest won by Beau Jardine in early June, but now 1lb lower than when winning on Polytrack here in December and has possibilities if this fast ground suits.
runners.comment: Not yet proven on turf but won off 1lb higher on Polytrack here in December; a possible

runners.name: Mighty Ruler
runners.spotlight: Led close home for narrow AW win here in January but that's his only success from 21 starts and he posed no threat on turf at Brighton last month; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Narrow AW winner here in January but posed no threat on turf last month; others preferred

runners.name: Saturday Again
runners.spotlight: Still unexposed after only five starts but raced too freely and was soundly beaten on handicap debut at Kempton (7f, AW) in February; returns from five-month break.
runners.comment: Remains unexposed but was soundly beaten after racing too freely on handicap debut

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Allegrino
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to score at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last month and is now 2-7; still unexposed on turf and promises to be suited by today's slightly longer trip; ought to be right in the thick of things.
runners.comment: Scored at Yarmouth last month and is now 2-7; still unexposed on turf; major player

runners.name: Wetsand
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo who needed significant help from the handicapper before her narrow win in first-time visor here (7f, good to firm; made all) ten days ago; went back up only 2lb for that, though; respected.
runners.comment: Made all in first-time visor here (7f) ten days ago and went back up only 2lb for that

runners.name: Distinct Spirit
runners.spotlight: Began season with two decent efforts over 1m before justifying skinny odds in tactical, four-runner contest at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) on Tuesday; effectively only 4lb higher under 5lb penalty here, and evidently in good nick.
runners.comment: Justified skinny odds in tactical, four-runner race at Ffos Las on Tuesday; 5lb penalty

runners.name: Burnham Square
runners.spotlight: Progressive turf performer, thriving at present and still not fully exposed; completed hat-trick in Listed race at Churchill Downs (1m3f) last time, beating smart Chapman's Peak (who received 5lb) by a neck, pair clear; previously wide-margin winner over 1m4f of Grade 2 at Keeneland and Grade 3 at Churchill Downs; the coming force in this division and can prove himself at top level today.
runners.comment: Wide-margin winner of Grade 2 and Grade 3, then won by neck in smart Listed; hard to beat

runners.name: Test Score
runners.spotlight: Benefited from excellent ride from Manny Franco when winning Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup Turf Invitational at Gulfstream in January (1m1f, firm) by a neck; back to form when beaten half a length by Deterministic in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) at Saratoga; best form at shorter than 1m2f but should get the trip.
runners.comment: Grade 1 Pegasus winner (1m1f) and close second in Grade 1 at Saratoga; should go well

runners.name: Mercante
runners.spotlight: Smart form when runner-up in 2026 in Grade 3 Kentucky Cup Classic at Turfway (1m1f, Tapeta) and Grade 2 Wise Dan Stakes at Churchill Downs (8.5f, turf; beaten just under 1l by Lagynos); best form at short of 1m2f and needs to step up in form too.
runners.comment: Runner-up in Grade 3 and Grade 2 over shorter in 2026; doubts over class and stamina

runners.name: Fort Washington
runners.spotlight: Last year's winner when he came off fast pace to beat Grand Sonata by half a length, with Integration close third; has struggled to reproduce that form, though did win Grade 3 Dinner Party Stakes (1m1f) at Laurel in May; respectable effort latest and maybe this track suits him, but on balance he looks opposable.
runners.comment: Struggling to reproduce form of last year's win, though did win Grade 3 in May; opposable

runners.name: Integration
runners.spotlight: Six wins from 18 starts include Grade 2s in 2023 and 2024; largely consistent since (close third in this last year) and beaten just under 2l by Deterministic when fifth in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) at Saratoga on last start; looks poised to make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Smart and consistent and close third to Fort Washington in this last year; must go well
runners.owner: West Point Thoroughbreds & Woodford Racing LLC

runners.name: Dresden Row
runners.spotlight: Smart and consistent type who has won three Grade 3s on Tapeta at Woodbine, including Autumn Stakes (1m1f) last November; showed himself just as good on turf (won allowance in May) when about 1l third to Lagynos in Grade 2 Wise Dan at Churchill Downs (8.5f) last time; best form at about 1m.
runners.comment: Has won three Grade 3s on Tapeta; probably best at about 1m; others appeal more

runners.name: Layabout
runners.spotlight: Grade 3 winner at Gulfstream Park (1m4f; good ride by David Egan) in January; better of two efforts since when fourth in Grade 3 on penultimate start but overall form leaves him plenty to find.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner in January (1m4f) but overall form leaves him plenty to find

runners.name: Gran Oriente
runners.spotlight: Chilean Grade 1 winner in 2025; very useful form to complete hat-trick outside graded events in USA (one at Santa Anita, two at Gulfstream); on latest start (second for current trainer) he justified favouritism by just over 1l in handicap at Gulfstream (8.5f) from stablemate Nemo; progressive and in excellent hands but needs to rediscover peak from former country if he's to contend.
runners.comment: Chilean Grade 1 winner; landed hat-trick in non-graded events in US but needs more
runners.owner: Epic Horses LLC, WSS Racing Et Al

races.race_name: Jim Dandy Stakes Presented By Mohegan Sun (Grade 2) (Dirt)

runners.name: Chip Honcho
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of a Grade 3 at Thistledown six weeks ago; successful three times in his last seven starts.
runners.comment: Tight-margin winner six weeks ago; on target three times in his last seven outings.
runners.owner: Leland Ackerley Racing LLC, James Sherwood et al

runners.name: Renegade
runners.spotlight: Normally pretty consistent and took the Grade 1 Arkansas Derby in March; finished just behind Commandment when third two months ago; might find this easier; has strong claims.
runners.comment: A leading contender; placed in the Belmont Stakes two months ago.
runners.owner: Robert Low, Lawana L Low & Repole Stable

runners.name: Commandment
runners.spotlight: Won the Grade 1 Florida Derby four months ago and producing consistent form; was on the premises in the Belmont Stakes (second, beaten just over 1l) two months ago; this is a step down in class; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Looks likely to be involved; placed in the Belmont Stakes two months ago.

runners.name: Asked And Answered
runners.spotlight: Although yet to hit the target, he has shown ability; held in seventh over 1m here (maiden claimer) last month; this line-up contains some strong opposition so others more likely.
runners.comment: Facing a testing assignment and there are better alternatives here.
runners.owner: Aci Racing Stable LLC & Gerardo Salinas

runners.name: Silent Tactic
runners.spotlight: On target twice in his last six outings; running consistently; solid effort in the Arkansas Derby, beaten 4l to finish runner-up behind Renegade (Oaklawn Park) in March; down in class; returns from a layoff here; competitive shout.
runners.comment: Can be in the thick of things; placed in the Arkansas Derby in March.

runners.name: Eunomia
runners.owner: St Elias Stables LLC & WSS Racing LLC

runners.name: Om N Joy
runners.owner: Baker Stables LLC, Michael Golovko & Terrence J Scanlan

runners.owner: Mme Genevieve Meunier, Elevage Des Vallons Et Al
